translations.idiomatic: He also passed the policy examination, left office in a feudal headquarters, and entered court as Director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 太和初，累遷給事中，宣慰幽州稱旨。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taihe he was repeatedly promoted to Supervising Censor and, as envoy to soothe You Prefecture, pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taihe he was repeatedly promoted to Supervising Censor and, as envoy to soothe You Prefecture, pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 俄而興元兵亂，殺李絳，命琯平亂褒中，三軍寂然從命。

translations.literal: Soon there was military disorder in Xingyuan and Li Jiang was killed; Guan was ordered to pacify the disorder in Bao and Han; the whole army silently obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon there was military disorder in Xingyuan and Li Jiang was killed; Guan was ordered to pacify the disorder in Bao and Han; the whole army silently obeyed.

sentences.zh: 使還，改工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On returning he was reassigned Vice Minister of Public Works.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he was reassigned Vice Minister of Public Works.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，拜京兆尹。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year he was appointed Chief of the Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year he was appointed Chief of the Capital.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，改尚書右丞。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year he was reassigned Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year he was reassigned Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月，出為江陵尹、御史大夫、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixth year he was sent out as Chief of Jiangling, Censor-in-Chief, and Jingnan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixth year he was sent out as Chief of Jiangling, Censor-in-Chief, and Jingnan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，入為兵部侍郎，轉吏部，權判左丞事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he entered court as Vice Minister of War, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and acted as Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he entered court as Vice Minister of War, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and acted as Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 開成二年，真拜左丞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaicheng he was formally appointed Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaicheng he was formally appointed Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 時弟珙為京兆尹，兄弟並居顯列。

translations.literal: At the time his younger brother Gong was Chief of the Capital; the brothers both stood in prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his younger brother Gong was Chief of the Capital; the brothers both stood in prominent posts.

sentences.zh: 以本官權判兵部西銓、吏部東銓事。

translations.literal: With his existing office he acted as Director of the Western Selection in the Ministry of War and the Eastern Selection in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: With his existing office he acted as Director of the Western Selection in the Ministry of War and the Eastern Selection in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三年，檢校戶部尚書，判東都尚書省事、東都留守、東畿汝都防禦等使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, Director of Eastern Capital Ministry Affairs, Eastern Capital Garrison Commander, and Defender of the Eastern Capital Circuit and Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, Director of Eastern Capital Ministry Affairs, Eastern Capital Garrison Commander, and Defender of the Eastern Capital Circuit and Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，遷銀青光祿大夫、檢校吏部尚書、興元尹，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he was transferred Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Acting Minister of Personnel, and Chief of Xingyuan, serving as Shannan West Circuit Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he was transferred Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Acting Minister of Personnel, and Chief of Xingyuan, serving as Shannan West Circuit Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以弟珙罷相貶官，琯亦罷鎮歸東都。

translations.literal: Because his younger brother Gong was removed as chief minister and demoted, Guan also left his command and returned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Because his younger brother Gong was removed as chief minister and demoted, Guan also left his command and returned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 五年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: An edict read:
translations.idiomatic: An edict read:

sentences.zh: 孔氏以顏、冉之行，首於四科；

translations.literal: Because the Kong clan took the conduct of Yan and Ran as foremost among the four categories;
translations.idiomatic: Because the Kong clan took the conduct of Yan and Ran as foremost among the four categories;

sentences.zh: 漢代以荀、陳之門，方之「八凱」。

translations.literal: in Han the gates of Xun and Chen were compared to the "Eight Worthies."
translations.idiomatic: in Han the gates of Xun and Chen were compared to the "Eight Worthies."

sentences.zh: 乃睠時哲，得茲令名，用舉飾終之恩，以抒殲良之嘆。

translations.literal: Now looking to the wise men of the age, this fine name is obtained; We use the grace of honoring the end to express the sigh over the loss of the good.
translations.idiomatic: Now looking to the wise men of the age, this fine name is obtained; We use the grace of honoring the end to express the sigh over the loss of the good.

sentences.zh: 故山南西道節度使崔琯，誠明履正，粹密鄰幾，有子政之精忠，得公綽之不欲。

translations.literal: The late Shannan West Circuit Military Commissioner Cui Guan was sincere, bright, upright, and pure and close to subtlety; he had the pure loyalty of Zichan and the unwillingness of Gongchuo.
translations.idiomatic: The late Shannan West Circuit Military Commissioner Cui Guan was sincere, bright, upright, and pure and close to subtlety; he had the pure loyalty of Zichan and the unwillingness of Gongchuo.

sentences.zh: 禮樂二事，以為身文；

translations.literal: In ritual and music he made the two his personal adornment;
translations.idiomatic: In ritual and music he made the two his personal adornment;

sentences.zh: 仁義五常，自成家範。

translations.literal: in benevolence, righteousness, and the five constants he formed his family's model.
translations.idiomatic: in benevolence, righteousness, and the five constants he formed his family's model.

sentences.zh: 往以茂器，列於大僚。

translations.literal: Formerly, with excellent capacity, he was ranked among the great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, with excellent capacity, he was ranked among the great ministers.

sentences.zh: 屬賢相受誣，廟堂議法，由長孺之道，以估正人；

translations.literal: When the worthy chief minister was slandered and the court hall debated the law, by Zhang Changru's way the upright man was appraised;
translations.idiomatic: When the worthy chief minister was slandered and the court hall debated the law, by Zhang Changru's way the upright man was appraised;

sentences.zh: 微京兆之言，豈聞非罪？

translations.literal: without the words of the Chief of the Capital, who would have heard of the innocent punished?
translations.idiomatic: without the words of the Chief of the Capital, who would have heard of the innocent punished?

sentences.zh: 既是魏其之直，益彰王鳳之邪。

translations.literal: Since it was Wei Qi's uprightness, Wang Feng's wickedness was shown still more.
translations.idiomatic: Since it was Wei Qi's uprightness, Wang Feng's wickedness was shown still more.

sentences.zh: 莊色於朝，群公聳視；

translations.literal: He stood stern in court and the multitude of lords looked up;
translations.idiomatic: He stood stern in court and the multitude of lords looked up;

sentences.zh: 讜詞不撓，淑問攸歸。

translations.literal: his forthright words did not bend and good repute returned to him.
translations.idiomatic: his forthright words did not bend and good repute returned to him.

sentences.zh: 歷踐名籓，皆留遺愛。

translations.literal: Passing through famous commands, he everywhere left enduring affection.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through famous commands, he everywhere left enduring affection.

sentences.zh: 居常慎獨，清則畏知。

translations.literal: In daily life he was cautious in solitude and in purity he feared being known.
translations.idiomatic: In daily life he was cautious in solitude and in purity he feared being known.

sentences.zh: 爰自青衿，迄於白首，厲翼之誌，始終不渝。

translations.literal: From blue-gowned youth to white-haired age, the will to strengthen wings never changed from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: From blue-gowned youth to white-haired age, the will to strengthen wings never changed from beginning to end.

sentences.zh: 未陟臺階，實辜公論；

translations.literal: He did not ascend the terrace steps—truly failing public opinion;
translations.idiomatic: He did not ascend the terrace steps—truly failing public opinion;

sentences.zh: 追榮左相，式示優崇。

translations.literal: posthumously honoring him as Left Vice Director shows exceptional esteem.
translations.idiomatic: posthumously honoring him as Left Vice Director shows exceptional esteem.

sentences.zh: 可贈尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: He may be posthumously granted Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously granted Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 珙，琯之母弟也。

translations.literal: Gong was Guan's younger brother by the same mother.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was Guan's younger brother by the same mother.

sentences.zh: 以書判拔萃高等，累佐使府。

translations.literal: With distinguished performance in document judgment he served repeatedly in headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: With distinguished performance in document judgment he served repeatedly in headquarters.

sentences.zh: 性威重，尤精吏術。

translations.literal: By nature he was stern and weighty and especially skilled in administrative technique.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was stern and weighty and especially skilled in administrative technique.

sentences.zh: 太和初，累官泗州刺史，入為太府卿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taihe he rose repeatedly to Prefect of Si and entered court as Grand Master of the Palace Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taihe he rose repeatedly to Prefect of Si and entered court as Grand Master of the Palace Treasury.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，拜廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year he was appointed Prefect of Guang and Lingnan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year he was appointed Prefect of Guang and Lingnan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 延英中謝，帝問以撫理南海之宜。

translations.literal: At an Yanying audience the emperor asked about governing and soothing the Southern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: At an Yanying audience the emperor asked about governing and soothing the Southern Sea.

sentences.zh: 珙奏對明辯，帝深嘉之。

translations.literal: Gong answered clearly and the emperor deeply praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Gong answered clearly and the emperor deeply praised him.

sentences.zh: 時高瑀鎮徐州，承智興之後，軍驕難制，軍士數犯法，上欲擇威望之帥以臨之，久難其才。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Yu governed Xu; following Zhixing the army was insubordinate and hard to control; soldiers repeatedly violated the law; the emperor wished to choose a commander of prestige to oversee them and for a long time found the talent hard to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Gao Yu governed Xu; following Zhixing the army was insubordinate and hard to control; soldiers repeatedly violated the law; the emperor wished to choose a commander of prestige to oversee them and for a long time found the talent hard to obtain.

sentences.zh: 會珙言事慷慨，謂宰臣曰：「崔珙言事，神氣精爽，此可以臨徐人。」

translations.literal: When Gong spoke on affairs with ardor, he told the chief ministers, "When Cui Gong speaks on affairs his spirit is sharp and refreshed—he can oversee the Xu people."
translations.idiomatic: When Gong spoke on affairs with ardor, he told the chief ministers, "When Cui Gong speaks on affairs his spirit is sharp and refreshed—he can oversee the Xu people."

sentences.zh: 即以王茂元代珙鎮廣南，授珙兼檢校工部尚書、徐州刺史、兼御史大夫，充武寧軍節度、徐泗濠觀察使。

translations.literal: Wang Maoyuan was at once sent to replace Gong in governing Guangnan; Gong was granted concurrent Acting Minister of Public Works, Prefect of Xu, and Censor-in-Chief, and served as Military Commissioner of the Wuning Army and Xu-Si-Hao Observer.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Maoyuan was at once sent to replace Gong in governing Guangnan; Gong was granted concurrent Acting Minister of Public Works, Prefect of Xu, and Censor-in-Chief, and served as Military Commissioner of the Wuning Army and Xu-Si-Hao Observer.

sentences.zh: 開成初，就加檢校兵部尚書。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng he was promoted Acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng he was promoted Acting Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二年，檢校吏部尚書、右金吾大將軍，充街使。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Acting Minister of Personnel and Right Golden Guard General and served as Street Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed Acting Minister of Personnel and Right Golden Guard General and served as Street Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月，遷京兆尹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was transferred Chief of the Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was transferred Chief of the Capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京畿旱，珙奏浐水入內者，十分量減九分，賜貧民溉田，從之。

translations.literal: That year the capital circuit suffered drought; Gong memorialized that water drawn from the Chan River for the inner palace should be reduced nine-tenths in measure and given to poor people to irrigate fields; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital circuit suffered drought; Gong memorialized that water drawn from the Chan River for the inner palace should be reduced nine-tenths in measure and given to poor people to irrigate fields; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，盜發親仁裏，欲殺宰相李石。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year robbers broke into Qinren Lane and wished to kill Chief Minister Li Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year robbers broke into Qinren Lane and wished to kill Chief Minister Li Shi.

sentences.zh: 其賊出於禁軍，珙坐捕盜不獲，罰俸料。

translations.literal: The robbers came from the forbidden army; Gong was fined salary for failing to capture the robbers.
translations.idiomatic: The robbers came from the forbidden army; Gong was fined salary for failing to capture the robbers.

sentences.zh: 會昌初，李德裕用事，與珙親厚，累遷戶部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huichang Li Deyu held power; he was close to Gong and repeatedly promoted him to Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huichang Li Deyu held power; he was close to Gong and repeatedly promoted him to Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.

sentences.zh: 尋以本官同中書門下平章事，累兼刑部尚書、門下侍郎，進階銀青光祿大夫，兼尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Soon with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, repeatedly concurrent Minister of Justice and Vice Director of the Secretariat, and was promoted Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance and concurrent Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, repeatedly concurrent Minister of Justice and Vice Director of the Secretariat, and was promoted Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance and concurrent Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 素與崔鉉不葉，及李讓夷引鉉輔政，代珙領使務，乃掎摭珙領使日妄破宋滑院鹽鐵錢九十萬貫文，又言珙嘗保護劉從諫，坐貶澧州刺，再貶恩州司馬。

translations.literal: He had long been at odds with Cui Xuan; when Li Rangyi brought Xuan into governing affairs and replaced Gong in directing the commission, Xuan gathered evidence that during Gong's tenure he had wantonly spent ninety thousand strings of Song-Hua circuit salt-and-iron money and also said Gong had once protected Liu Congjian; Gong was demoted Prefect of Li and again demoted Assistant Administrator of En.
translations.idiomatic: He had long been at odds with Cui Xuan; when Li Rangyi brought Xuan into governing affairs and replaced Gong in directing the commission, Xuan gathered evidence that during Gong's tenure he had wantonly spent ninety thousand strings of Song-Hua circuit salt-and-iron money and also said Gong had once protected Liu Congjian; Gong was demoted Prefect of Li and again demoted Assistant Administrator of En.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，以赦召還，為太子賓客，出為鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded, he was recalled by amnesty and appointed Crown Prince Guest, then sent out as Fengxiang Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded, he was recalled by amnesty and appointed Crown Prince Guest, then sent out as Fengxiang Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三年，崔鉉復知政事，珙辭疾請罷。

translations.literal: In the third year Cui Xuan again directed governing affairs; Gong pleaded illness and requested dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Cui Xuan again directed governing affairs; Gong pleaded illness and requested dismissal.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「將相大臣，與國同體，誠欲自便，豈宜不從？

translations.literal: An edict read: "Chief ministers and generals share the same body as the state; if they truly wish their own convenience, how should We not grant it?
translations.idiomatic: An edict read, "Chief ministers and generals share the same body as the state; if they truly wish their own convenience, how should We not grant it?

sentences.zh: 茍非其時，涉於避事。

translations.literal: If the time is not right, it touches on avoiding affairs.
translations.idiomatic: If the time is not right, it touches on avoiding affairs.

sentences.zh: 前鳳翔隴州節度觀察處置等使、光祿大夫、檢校尚書右僕射、兼鳳翔尹、御史大夫、上柱國、安平郡開國公、食邑二千戶崔珙，早以器能，周歷顯重。

translations.literal: The former Fengxiang-Long Military Commissioner and Observer, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Acting Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, concurrent Chief of Fengxiang, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Duke of Anping with a fief of two thousand households Cui Gong, early showed capacity and passed through prominent and weighty posts.
translations.idiomatic: The former Fengxiang-Long Military Commissioner and Observer, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Acting Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, concurrent Chief of Fengxiang, Censor-in-Chief, Pillar of State, Duke of Anping with a fief of two thousand households Cui Gong, early showed capacity and passed through prominent and weighty posts.

sentences.zh: 行己每稱其友悌，在公亦竭其精忠。

translations.literal: In personal conduct he always praised friendship and brotherly respect; in public service he also exhausted pure loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: In personal conduct he always praised friendship and brotherly respect; in public service he also exhausted pure loyalty.

sentences.zh: 自負譴前朝，遠移南僥，及我嗣守，頗聞嘉名。

translations.literal: Since bearing punishment in the former court he was transferred far to the southern exile; when We succeeded and kept the throne, his fine name was much heard.
translations.idiomatic: Since bearing punishment in the former court he was transferred far to the southern exile; when We succeeded and kept the throne, his fine name was much heard.

sentences.zh: 由是剖竹近關，揚旍右輔，為國垣翰，適資謀猷。

translations.literal: Therefore he was given bamboo staff near the Pass and raised his banner in the right auxiliary region, serving as the state's wall and fence and supplying counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he was given bamboo staff near the Pass and raised his banner in the right auxiliary region, serving as the state's wall and fence and supplying counsel.

sentences.zh: 近者犬戎輸誠，歸我故地，下議納款，且籌開疆。

translations.literal: Recently the dog barbarians offered sincerity and returned Our old lands; subordinates discussed accepting submission and also planned to open the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the dog barbarians offered sincerity and returned Our old lands; subordinates discussed accepting submission and also planned to open the frontier.

sentences.zh: 宜其率先啟行，副此寵待。

translations.literal: He should have been first to set out and respond to this favored treatment.
translations.idiomatic: He should have been first to set out and respond to this favored treatment.

sentences.zh: 忽覽退閑之請，頗乖毗倚之誠。

translations.literal: Suddenly We read a request for retirement—quite at odds with the trust of support.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly We read a request for retirement—quite at odds with the trust of support.

sentences.zh: 陳力之方，豈無其道？

translations.literal: In exerting strength—is there not a way?
translations.idiomatic: In exerting strength—is there not a way?

sentences.zh: 匪躬之故，或異於是。

translations.literal: For not giving one's person—perhaps it differs from this.
translations.idiomatic: For not giving one's person—perhaps it differs from this.

sentences.zh: 以其故老，特為優容，俾居青宮之輔，仍從分洛之命。

translations.literal: Because of his old age We specially show favor and ease, appointing him Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince while still following the order to serve in the Eastern Capital branch.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his old age We specially show favor and ease, appointing him Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince while still following the order to serve in the Eastern Capital branch.

sentences.zh: 君臣禮分，予無愧焉。

translations.literal: In the ritual division between ruler and minister We have no cause for shame.
translations.idiomatic: In the ritual division between ruler and minister We have no cause for shame.

sentences.zh: 可太子少師，分司東都。」

translations.literal: He may be Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, serving in the Eastern Capital branch office."
translations.idiomatic: He may be Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, serving in the Eastern Capital branch office."

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 子涓，大中四年進士擢第。

translations.literal: His son was Juan, who in the fourth year of Dazhong passed the jinshi selection.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Juan, who in the fourth year of Dazhong passed the jinshi selection.

sentences.zh: 珙弟瑨、璪、璵、球、珦。

translations.literal: Gong's younger brothers were Jin, Can, Yu, Qiu, and Shao.
translations.idiomatic: Gong's younger brothers were Jin, Can, Yu, Qiu, and Shao.

sentences.zh: 瑨以書判拔萃，開成中，累遷至刑部郎中。

translations.literal: Jin, with distinguished performance in document judgment, in the Kaicheng era was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Jin, with distinguished performance in document judgment, in the Kaicheng era was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，歷三郡刺史，位終方鎮。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he served successively as prefect of three prefectures and ended as a regional commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he served successively as prefect of three prefectures and ended as a regional commissioner.

sentences.zh: 璪，開成初，為吏部郎中，轉給事中。

translations.literal: Can, at the beginning of Kaicheng, served as Director in the Ministry of Personnel and was transferred Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Can, at the beginning of Kaicheng, served as Director in the Ministry of Personnel and was transferred Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 會昌初，出為陜虢觀察使，遷河南尹，入為御史中丞，轉吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huichang he was sent out as Shaan-Guo Observer, transferred Chief of Henan, entered court as Censor-in-Chief, and was transferred Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huichang he was sent out as Shaan-Guo Observer, transferred Chief of Henan, entered court as Censor-in-Chief, and was transferred Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 大中初，改兵部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was reassigned Vice Minister of War and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was reassigned Vice Minister of War and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.

sentences.zh: 崔鉉再輔政，罷璪使務，檢校兵部尚書，兼河中尹、御史大夫，充河中晉絳磁隰等州節度觀察使。

translations.literal: When Cui Xuan again directed governing affairs he removed Can from the commission and appointed him Acting Minister of War, concurrent Chief of Hezhong, Censor-in-Chief, and Military Commissioner and Observer of Hezhong, Jin-Jiang, Ci, and Li prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Xuan again directed governing affairs he removed Can from the commission and appointed him Acting Minister of War, concurrent Chief of Hezhong, Censor-in-Chief, and Military Commissioner and Observer of Hezhong, Jin-Jiang, Ci, and Li prefectures.

sentences.zh: 七年，入為左丞，再遷刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he entered court as Left Vice Director and was again transferred Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he entered court as Left Vice Director and was again transferred Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 子滔，大中初登進士第。

translations.literal: His son was Tao, who at the beginning of Dazhong passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Tao, who at the beginning of Dazhong passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 璵，字朗士，長慶初進士擢第，又制策登科。

translations.literal: Yu, styled Langshi, at the beginning of Changqing passed the jinshi selection and also passed the policy examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yu, styled Langshi, at the beginning of Changqing passed the jinshi selection and also passed the policy examination.

sentences.zh: 開成末，累遷至禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: At the end of Kaicheng he was repeatedly promoted to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Kaicheng he was repeatedly promoted to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 會昌初，以考功郎中知制誥，拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huichang, as Director in the Ministry of Personnel he directed proclamations and was appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huichang, as Director in the Ministry of Personnel he directed proclamations and was appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大中五年，遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong he was transferred Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Dazhong he was transferred Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 六年，選士，時謂得才。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he selected candidates; people of the time said he obtained talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he selected candidates; people of the time said he obtained talent.

sentences.zh: 七年，權知戶部侍郎，進封博陵子，食邑五百戶，轉兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he acted as Vice Minister of Revenue, was enfeoffed as Baron of Boling with a fief of five hundred households, and was transferred Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he acted as Vice Minister of Revenue, was enfeoffed as Baron of Boling with a fief of five hundred households, and was transferred Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 子澹。

translations.literal: His son was Dan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Dan.

sentences.zh: 澹，大中十三年，登進士第，累遷禮部員外郎，位終吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Dan, in the thirteenth year of Dazhong passed the jinshi examination, was repeatedly promoted to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Rites, and ended as Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Dan, in the thirteenth year of Dazhong passed the jinshi examination, was repeatedly promoted to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Rites, and ended as Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 淡子遠。

translations.literal: Dan's son was Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dan's son was Yuan.

sentences.zh: 遠，龍紀元年，登進士第。

translations.literal: Yuan, in the first year of Longji passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan, in the first year of Longji passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 大順初，以員外郎知制誥，召充翰林學士，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Datong, as Outer Court Attendant he directed proclamations and was summoned to serve as Hanlin Academician and formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Datong, as Outer Court Attendant he directed proclamations and was summoned to serve as Hanlin Academician and formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乾寧三年，轉戶部侍郎、博陵縣男、食邑三百戶，轉兵部侍郎承旨。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianning he was transferred Vice Minister of Revenue, Baron of Boling with a fief of three hundred households, and transferred Vice Minister of War as Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianning he was transferred Vice Minister of Revenue, Baron of Boling with a fief of three hundred households, and transferred Vice Minister of War as Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋以本官同平章事，遷中書侍郎，兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, transferred Vice Director of the Secretariat, and concurrent Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, transferred Vice Director of the Secretariat, and concurrent Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 天祐初，從昭宗東遷洛陽。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou he followed Emperor Zhaozong east to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianyou he followed Emperor Zhaozong east to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 罷相，守右僕射。

translations.literal: Removed as chief minister, he served as Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Removed as chief minister, he served as Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 二年，為柳璨希、朱全忠旨，累貶白州長史。

translations.literal: In the second year, at the behest of Liu Can and Zhu Quanzhong, he was repeatedly demoted to Chief Administrator of Bai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, at the behest of Liu Can and Zhu Quanzhong, he was repeatedly demoted to Chief Administrator of Bai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 行至滑州，被害於白馬驛。

translations.literal: When he reached Hua Prefecture he was killed at Baima Post.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Hua Prefecture he was killed at Baima Post.

sentences.zh: 遠文才清麗，風神峻整，人皆慕其為人，當時目為「釘座梨」，言席上之珍也。

translations.literal: Yuan's literary talent was clear and beautiful, his bearing lofty and composed; everyone admired his character, and people of the time called him "the pear that nails the seat," meaning a treasure of the banquet table.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan's literary talent was clear and beautiful, his bearing lofty and composed; everyone admired his character, and people of the time called him "the pear that nails the seat," meaning a treasure of the banquet table.

sentences.zh: 球，字叔休，寶歷二年登進士第。

translations.literal: Qiu, styled Shuxiu, in the second year of Baoli passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu, styled Shuxiu, in the second year of Baoli passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，為鳳翔節度判官，入朝為尚書郎。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he served as staff judge of the Fengxiang Military Commission and entered court as Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he served as staff judge of the Fengxiang Military Commission and entered court as Director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 子瀆。

translations.literal: His son was Du.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Du.

sentences.zh: 瀆，大中末亦進士登第。

translations.literal: Du also passed the jinshi examination at the end of Dazhong.
translations.idiomatic: Du also passed the jinshi examination at the end of Dazhong.

sentences.zh: 崔氏咸通、乾符間，昆仲子弟紆組拖紳，歷臺閣、錢籓嶽者二十余人。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong and Qianfu eras, among the Cui clan brothers and sons more than twenty wore official sashes and served in the censorate, treasury, and regional commands.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong and Qianfu eras, among the Cui clan brothers and sons more than twenty wore official sashes and served in the censorate, treasury, and regional commands.

sentences.zh: 大中以來盛族，時推甲等。

translations.literal: Since Dazhong they have been a great clan; people of the time ranked them first class.
translations.idiomatic: Since Dazhong they have been a great clan; people of the time ranked them first class.

sentences.zh: 盧鈞，字子和，本范陽人。

translations.literal: Lu Jun, styled Zihe, was originally from Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jun, styled Zihe, was originally from Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 祖炅，父繼。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Jiong and his father Ji.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Jiong and his father Ji.

sentences.zh: 鈞，元和四年進士擢第，又書判拔萃，調補校書郎，累佐諸侯府。

translations.literal: Jun, in the fourth year of Yuanhe passed the jinshi selection and also distinguished himself in document judgment; he was appointed proofreader and repeatedly served in feudal headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Jun, in the fourth year of Yuanhe passed the jinshi selection and also distinguished himself in document judgment; he was appointed proofreader and repeatedly served in feudal headquarters.

sentences.zh: 太和五年，遷左補闕。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taihe he was transferred Left Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Taihe he was transferred Left Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 與同職理宋申錫之枉，由是知名。

translations.literal: Together with colleagues he righted the injustice of Song Shenxi and thereby became known.
translations.idiomatic: Together with colleagues he righted the injustice of Song Shenxi and thereby became known.

sentences.zh: 歷尚書郎，出為常州刺史。

translations.literal: He passed through Director in the Ministry of Revenue and was sent out as Prefect of Chang.
translations.idiomatic: He passed through Director in the Ministry of Revenue and was sent out as Prefect of Chang.

sentences.zh: 九年，拜給事中。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 開成元年，出為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaicheng he was sent out as Prefect of Hua, Defender of Tong Pass, and Commander of the Zhenguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng he was sent out as Prefect of Hua, Defender of Tong Pass, and Commander of the Zhenguo Army.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，代李從易為廣州刺史、御史大夫、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: That winter he replaced Li Congyi as Prefect of Guang, Censor-in-Chief, and Lingnan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he replaced Li Congyi as Prefect of Guang, Censor-in-Chief, and Lingnan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 南海有蠻舶之利，珍貨輻湊。

translations.literal: In the Southern Sea there were profits from barbarian merchant ships; precious goods gathered in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: In the Southern Sea there were profits from barbarian merchant ships; precious goods gathered in abundance.

sentences.zh: 舊帥作法興利以致富，凡為南海者，靡不梱載而還。

translations.literal: Former commanders made laws to create profit and grow rich; everyone who served in the Southern Sea returned laden with goods.
translations.idiomatic: Former commanders made laws to create profit and grow rich; everyone who served in the Southern Sea returned laden with goods.

sentences.zh: 鈞性仁恕，為政廉潔，請監軍領市舶使，己一不干預。

translations.literal: Jun was benevolent and forgiving by nature, governed with integrity, requested that the army supervisor direct the maritime trade commissioner, and himself did not interfere at all.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was benevolent and forgiving by nature, governed with integrity, requested that the army supervisor direct the maritime trade commissioner, and himself did not interfere at all.

sentences.zh: 自貞元已來，衣冠得罪流放嶺表者，因而物故，子孫貧悴，雖遇赦不能自還。

translations.literal: Since Zhenyuan, officials and gentry who offended and were exiled beyond the Ling Range often died there; their descendants were poor and distressed and even when amnesties came could not return on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhenyuan, officials and gentry who offended and were exiled beyond the Ling Range often died there; their descendants were poor and distressed and even when amnesties came could not return on their own.

sentences.zh: 凡在封境者，鈞減俸錢為營槥櫝。

translations.literal: All who were within his jurisdiction Jun aided with reduced salary to provide coffins.
translations.idiomatic: All who were within his jurisdiction Jun aided with reduced salary to provide coffins.

sentences.zh: 其家疾病死喪，則為之醫藥殯殮，孤兒稚女，為之婚嫁，凡數百家。

translations.literal: When families had illness, death, or mourning he provided medicine, burial, and coffins; for orphaned boys and young girls he arranged marriages—altogether several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When families had illness, death, or mourning he provided medicine, burial, and coffins; for orphaned boys and young girls he arranged marriages—altogether several hundred households.

sentences.zh: 由是山越之俗，服其德義，令不嚴而人化。

translations.literal: Because of this the customs of the mountain Yue submitted to his virtue and righteousness; orders need not be strict yet people were transformed.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this the customs of the mountain Yue submitted to his virtue and righteousness; orders need not be strict yet people were transformed.

sentences.zh: 三年將代，華蠻數千人詣闕請立生祠，銘功頌德。

translations.literal: When in the third year he was about to be replaced, several thousand mountain barbarians went to the court requesting a living shrine and inscribing his merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: When in the third year he was about to be replaced, several thousand mountain barbarians went to the court requesting a living shrine and inscribing his merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 先是土人與蠻獠雜居，婚娶相通，吏或撓之，相誘為亂。

translations.literal: Formerly natives and barbarian Liao lived mixed together and intermarried; officials sometimes interfered and incited one another to disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly natives and barbarian Liao lived mixed together and intermarried; officials sometimes interfered and incited one another to disorder.

sentences.zh: 鈞至，立法，俾華蠻異處，婚娶不通，蠻人不得立田宅；

translations.literal: When Jun arrived he made laws requiring natives and barbarians to live separately and forbidding intermarriage; barbarians could not establish fields or dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: When Jun arrived he made laws requiring natives and barbarians to live separately and forbidding intermarriage; barbarians could not establish fields or dwellings;

sentences.zh: 由是僥外肅清，而不相犯。

translations.literal: because of this the outer fringes were cleared and they did not violate one another.
translations.idiomatic: because of this the outer fringes were cleared and they did not violate one another.

sentences.zh: 會昌初，遷襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huichang he was transferred Prefect of Xiang and Shannan East Circuit Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huichang he was transferred Prefect of Xiang and Shannan East Circuit Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年，誅劉稹，以鈞檢校兵部尚書，兼潞州大都督府長史、昭義節度、澤潞邢洺磁觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when Liu Zhen was executed, Jun was appointed Acting Minister of War, Chief Administrator of Lu Superior Protectorate, and Zhaoyi Military Commissioner and Observer of Ze, Lu, Xing, Mo, Ci, and Guan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when Liu Zhen was executed, Jun was appointed Acting Minister of War, Chief Administrator of Lu Superior Protectorate, and Zhaoyi Military Commissioner and Observer of Ze, Lu, Xing, Mo, Ci, and Guan.

sentences.zh: 是冬，詔鈞出潞軍五千戍代北。

translations.literal: That winter an edict ordered Jun to send five thousand Lu troops to garrison the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That winter an edict ordered Jun to send five thousand Lu troops to garrison the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 鈞升城門餞送，其家設幄觀之。

translations.literal: Jun ascended the city gate to see them off; their families set up tents to watch.
translations.idiomatic: Jun ascended the city gate to see them off; their families set up tents to watch.

sentences.zh: 潞卒素驕，因與家人訣別，乘醉倒戈攻城門。

translations.literal: Lu soldiers had long been insubordinate; as they took leave of families and grew drunk they turned their spears and stormed the city gate.
translations.idiomatic: Lu soldiers had long been insubordinate; as they took leave of families and grew drunk they turned their spears and stormed the city gate.

sentences.zh: 監軍以州兵拒之，至晚撫勞方定。

translations.literal: The army supervisor resisted with prefectural troops; by evening, after soothing and encouraging them, order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The army supervisor resisted with prefectural troops; by evening, after soothing and encouraging them, order was restored.

sentences.zh: 詔鈞入朝，拜戶部侍郎、判度支，遷戶部尚書。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jun to enter court; he was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of the Revenue Bureau, then transferred Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jun to enter court; he was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of the Revenue Bureau, then transferred Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 大中初，檢校尚書右僕射、汴州刺史、御史大夫、宣武軍節度、宋亳汴潁觀察等使，就加檢校司空。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was appointed Acting Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Prefect of Bian, Censor-in-Chief, and Xuanwu Military Commissioner and Song-Bo-Bian-Ying Observer, and was promoted Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was appointed Acting Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Prefect of Bian, Censor-in-Chief, and Xuanwu Military Commissioner and Song-Bo-Bian-Ying Observer, and was promoted Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 四年，入為太子少師，進位上柱國、范陽郡開國公、食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he entered court as Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince and was promoted Pillar of State, Duke of Fanyang with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he entered court as Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince and was promoted Pillar of State, Duke of Fanyang with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 六年，復檢校司空、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again served as Acting Minister of Works, Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again served as Acting Minister of Works, Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔曰：「河東軍節度使盧鈞，長才博達，敏識宏深。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict read: "Hedong Military Commissioner Lu Jun has long talent, broad attainment, keen knowledge, and profound depth.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year an edict read, "Hedong Military Commissioner Lu Jun has long talent, broad attainment, keen knowledge, and profound depth.

sentences.zh: 藹山河之靈，抱瑚璉之器。

translations.literal: He embraces the spirit of mountains and rivers and holds vessels of coral and jade.
translations.idiomatic: He embraces the spirit of mountains and rivers and holds vessels of coral and jade.

sentences.zh: 多能不耀，用晦而彰。

translations.literal: With many abilities he does not display them; using obscurity he shows himself.
translations.idiomatic: With many abilities he does not display them; using obscurity he shows himself.

sentences.zh: 由嶺表而至太原，五換節鉞，仁聲載路，公論彌高。

translations.literal: From beyond the ranges to Taiyuan he changed the military commission five times; benevolent reputation filled the roads and public judgment grew ever higher.
translations.idiomatic: From beyond the ranges to Taiyuan he changed the military commission five times; benevolent reputation filled the roads and public judgment grew ever higher.

sentences.zh: 籓垣之和氣不衰，臺閣之清風常在，宜升揆路，以表群僚。

translations.literal: The harmonious spirit of the frontier wall has not declined; the pure wind of the terrace pavilion ever remains—he should ascend to the chief-minister path to show the model for all officials.
translations.idiomatic: The harmonious spirit of the frontier wall has not declined; the pure wind of the terrace pavilion ever remains—he should ascend to the chief-minister path to show the model for all officials.

sentences.zh: 可尚書左僕射。」

translations.literal: He may be Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works."
translations.idiomatic: He may be Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works."

sentences.zh: 鈞踐歷中外，事功益茂，後輩子弟，多至臺司。

translations.literal: Jun passed through inner and outer service and his achievements grew ever richer; younger kinsmen and sons often reached the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Jun passed through inner and outer service and his achievements grew ever richer; younger kinsmen and sons often reached the censorate.

sentences.zh: 至是急征，謂當輔弼，雖居端揆，心殊失望。

translations.literal: At this urgent summons he thought he would assist and counsel, yet though he stood at the summit his heart was quite disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: At this urgent summons he thought he would assist and counsel, yet though he stood at the summit his heart was quite disappointed.

sentences.zh: 常移病不視事，與親舊遊城南別墅，或累日一歸。

translations.literal: He often pleaded illness and did not attend to affairs, roaming with kin and old friends at a southern capital villa, sometimes returning only once in several days.
translations.idiomatic: He often pleaded illness and did not attend to affairs, roaming with kin and old friends at a southern capital villa, sometimes returning only once in several days.

sentences.zh: 宰臣令狐綯惡之，乃罷僕射，仍加檢校司空，守太子太師。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Linghu Tao disliked this and removed him from Vice Director while still adding Acting Minister of Works and appointing him Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Linghu Tao disliked this and removed him from Vice Director while still adding Acting Minister of Works and appointing him Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 物議以鈞長者，罪綯弄權。

translations.literal: Public opinion held Jun a man of length and blamed Tao for manipulating power.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion held Jun a man of length and blamed Tao for manipulating power.

sentences.zh: 綯懼。

translations.literal: Tao was afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Tao was afraid.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月，以鈞檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事、興元尹，充山南西道節度使，入為太子太師，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eleventh year Jun was appointed Acting Minister of Education, Associate Chief Minister, and Chief of Xingyuan, serving as Shannan West Circuit Military Commissioner; he entered court as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eleventh year Jun was appointed Acting Minister of Education, Associate Chief Minister, and Chief of Xingyuan, serving as Shannan West Circuit Military Commissioner; he entered court as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince and died.

sentences.zh: 裴休，字公美，河內濟源人也。

translations.literal: Pei Xiu, styled Gongmei, was a native of Jiyuan in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Xiu, styled Gongmei, was a native of Jiyuan in Henan.

sentences.zh: 祖宣，父肅。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Xuan and his father Su.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Xuan and his father Su.

sentences.zh: 肅，貞元中自常州刺史兼御史中丞、越州刺史、浙東團練觀察等使。

translations.literal: Su, in the Zhenyuan era, served from Prefect of Chang as concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Prefect of Yue, and Zhedong Training-and-Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Su, in the Zhenyuan era, served from Prefect of Chang as concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Prefect of Yue, and Zhedong Training-and-Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時山賊栗锽誘山越為亂，陷浙東郡縣。

translations.literal: At the time the mountain bandit Li Heng incited the mountain Yue to revolt and captured Zhedong cities and districts.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the mountain bandit Li Heng incited the mountain Yue to revolt and captured Zhedong cities and districts.

sentences.zh: 肅召州兵討平之，因紀其事，號《平戎記》，上之。

translations.literal: Su summoned prefectural troops to suppress and pacify them and recorded the affair in a work called Record of Pacifying the Barbarians, which he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Su summoned prefectural troops to suppress and pacify them and recorded the affair in a work called Record of Pacifying the Barbarians, which he submitted.

sentences.zh: 德宗嘉賞。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 肅生三子，儔、休、俅，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: Su had three sons—Chou, Xiu, and Qiu—all of whom passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Su had three sons—Chou, Xiu, and Qiu—all of whom passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 休誌操堅正。

translations.literal: Xiu's will and conduct were firm and upright.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu's will and conduct were firm and upright.

sentences.zh: 童齔時，兄弟同學於濟源別墅。

translations.literal: When still a child the brothers studied together at the Jiyuan villa.
translations.idiomatic: When still a child the brothers studied together at the Jiyuan villa.

sentences.zh: 休經年不出墅門，晝講經籍，夜課詩賦。

translations.literal: Xiu for a whole year did not leave the villa gate; by day he lectured on the classics and at night worked on poetry and rhapsodies.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu for a whole year did not leave the villa gate; by day he lectured on the classics and at night worked on poetry and rhapsodies.

sentences.zh: 虞人有以鹿贄儔者，儔、俅炰之，召休食。

translations.literal: A forester presented a deer to Chou as tribute; Chou and Qiu roasted it and summoned Xiu to eat.
translations.idiomatic: A forester presented a deer to Chou as tribute; Chou and Qiu roasted it and summoned Xiu to eat.

sentences.zh: 休曰：「我等窮生，菜食不充，今日食肉，翌日何繼？

translations.literal: Xiu said, "We are poor by birth; vegetable food is not enough—if we eat meat today, what shall we follow tomorrow?
translations.idiomatic: Xiu said, "We are poor by birth; vegetable food is not enough—if we eat meat today, what shall we follow tomorrow?

sentences.zh: 無宜改饌。」

translations.literal: We should not change the fare."
translations.idiomatic: We should not change the fare."

sentences.zh: 獨不食。

translations.literal: He alone did not eat.
translations.idiomatic: He alone did not eat.

sentences.zh: 長慶中，從鄉賦登第，又應賢良方正，升甲科。

translations.literal: In the Changqing era he passed the local examination and also answered the Exemplary and Upright examination, rising to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the Changqing era he passed the local examination and also answered the Exemplary and Upright examination, rising to first rank.

sentences.zh: 太和初，歷諸籓辟召，入為監察御史、右補闕、史館修撰。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taihe he was repeatedly summoned to regional headquarters and entered court as Attending Censor, Right Remonstrator, and Historiographer.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taihe he was repeatedly summoned to regional headquarters and entered court as Attending Censor, Right Remonstrator, and Historiographer.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，自尚書郎歷典數郡。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era, from Director in the Ministry of Revenue he passed through several prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era, from Director in the Ministry of Revenue he passed through several prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中初，累官戶部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使，轉兵部侍郎，兼御史大夫，領使如故。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue, Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits, then Vice Minister of War and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, continuing as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue, Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits, then Vice Minister of War and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, continuing as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，以本官同平章事，判使如故。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and continued as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and continued as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自太和已來，重臣領使者，歲漕江、淮米不過四十萬石，能至渭河倉者十不三四。

translations.literal: Since Taihe, when heavy ministers directed the commission, yearly transport of Yangtze-Huai rice did not exceed four hundred thousand shi, and not even three or four tenths reached the Wei River granary.
translations.idiomatic: Since Taihe, when heavy ministers directed the commission, yearly transport of Yangtze-Huai rice did not exceed four hundred thousand shi, and not even three or four tenths reached the Wei River granary.

sentences.zh: 漕吏狡蠹，敗溺百端。

translations.literal: Transport clerks were crafty and corrupt; losses and drownings had a hundred aspects.
translations.idiomatic: Transport clerks were crafty and corrupt; losses and drownings had a hundred aspects.

sentences.zh: 官舟沈溺者，歲七十余只。

translations.literal: Official boats that sank numbered more than seventy each year.
translations.idiomatic: Official boats that sank numbered more than seventy each year.

sentences.zh: 緣河奸史，大紊劉晏之法。

translations.literal: Corrupt clerks along the river greatly disrupted Liu Yan's methods.
translations.idiomatic: Corrupt clerks along the river greatly disrupted Liu Yan's methods.

sentences.zh: 洎休領使，分命僚佐深按其弊。

translations.literal: When Xiu took charge he ordered subordinates to investigate the abuses deeply.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiu took charge he ordered subordinates to investigate the abuses deeply.

sentences.zh: 因是所過地裏，悉令縣令兼董漕事，能者獎之。

translations.literal: Therefore in every place passed through he ordered magistrates to oversee transport affairs jointly and rewarded the capable.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore in every place passed through he ordered magistrates to oversee transport affairs jointly and rewarded the capable.

sentences.zh: 自江津達渭口，以四十萬之傭，歲計緡錢二十八萬貫，悉使歸諸漕吏，巡院無得侵牟。

translations.literal: From the Yangtze ferry to the mouth of the Wei, of the four hundred thousand in hired labor, yearly calculation was twenty-eight thousand strings of cash, all given to transport clerks while patrol offices could not encroach.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yangtze ferry to the mouth of the Wei, of the four hundred thousand in hired labor, yearly calculation was twenty-eight thousand strings of cash, all given to transport clerks while patrol offices could not encroach.

sentences.zh: 舉新法凡十條，奏行之，又立稅茶法二十條，奏行之，物議是之。

translations.literal: He established ten articles of new law and memorialized their implementation, and also established twenty articles of tea tax law and memorialized their implementation; public opinion approved.
translations.idiomatic: He established ten articles of new law and memorialized their implementation, and also established twenty articles of tea tax law and memorialized their implementation; public opinion approved.

sentences.zh: 初，休典使三歲，漕米至渭、河倉者一百二十萬斛，更無沈舟之弊。

translations.literal: At first, during Xiu's three years directing the commission, transported rice reaching the Wei and Yellow River granaries totaled 1.2 million hu, with no further loss from sunk boats.
translations.idiomatic: At first, during Xiu's three years directing the commission, transported rice reaching the Wei and Yellow River granaries totaled 1.2 million hu, with no further loss from sunk boats.

sentences.zh: 累轉中書侍郎，兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly transferred Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly transferred Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 休在相位五年。

translations.literal: Xiu was in the chief-minister position five years.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu was in the chief-minister position five years.

sentences.zh: 十年，罷相，檢校戶部尚書、汴州刺史、御史大夫，充宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was removed as chief minister and appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, Prefect of Bian, Censor-in-Chief, and Xuanwu Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was removed as chief minister and appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, Prefect of Bian, Censor-in-Chief, and Xuanwu Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，進階金紫光祿大夫、上柱國、河東縣子、食邑五百戶，守太子少保，分司東都。

translations.literal: That winter he was promoted Golden Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Pillar of State, Baron of Hedong with a fief of five hundred households, and appointed Junior Protector of the Crown Prince, serving in the Eastern Capital branch.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was promoted Golden Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Pillar of State, Baron of Hedong with a fief of five hundred households, and appointed Junior Protector of the Crown Prince, serving in the Eastern Capital branch.

sentences.zh: 十一年冬，檢校戶部尚書、潞州大都督府長史、御史大夫，充昭義節度、潞磁邢洺觀察使。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eleventh year he was appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, Chief Administrator of Lu Superior Protectorate, Censor-in-Chief, and Zhaoyi Military Commissioner and Observer of Lu, Ci, Xing, Mo, and Guan.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eleventh year he was appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, Chief Administrator of Lu Superior Protectorate, Censor-in-Chief, and Zhaoyi Military Commissioner and Observer of Lu, Ci, Xing, Mo, and Guan.

sentences.zh: 十三年十月，加檢校吏部尚書、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the thirteenth year he was promoted Acting Minister of Personnel, Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner and Observer.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the thirteenth year he was promoted Acting Minister of Personnel, Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner and Observer.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，以本官兼鳳翔尹，充鳳翔隴州節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, with his existing office he was made concurrent Chief of Fengxiang and Fengxiang-Long Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, with his existing office he was made concurrent Chief of Fengxiang and Fengxiang-Long Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 咸通初，入為戶部尚書，累遷吏部尚書、太子少師，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiantong he entered court as Minister of Revenue, was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Personnel and Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiantong he entered court as Minister of Revenue, was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Personnel and Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, and died.

sentences.zh: 休性寬惠，為官不尚曒察，而吏民畏服。

translations.literal: Xiu was generous and mild by nature; in office he did not delight in harsh scrutiny, yet clerks and people feared and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu was generous and mild by nature; in office he did not delight in harsh scrutiny, yet clerks and people feared and submitted.

sentences.zh: 善為文，長於書翰，自成筆法。

translations.literal: He was good at writing and skilled in calligraphy, forming his own brush method.
translations.idiomatic: He was good at writing and skilled in calligraphy, forming his own brush method.

sentences.zh: 家世奉佛，休尤深於釋典。

translations.literal: His family for generations honored Buddhism; Xiu was especially deep in Buddhist scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: His family for generations honored Buddhism; Xiu was especially deep in Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 太原、鳳翔近名山，多僧寺。

translations.literal: Taiyuan and Fengxiang are near famous mountains with many monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan and Fengxiang are near famous mountains with many monasteries.

sentences.zh: 視事之隙，遊踐山林，與義學僧講求佛理。

translations.literal: In the intervals of governing affairs he wandered among mountain forests and discussed Buddhist principles with scholar-monks.
translations.idiomatic: In the intervals of governing affairs he wandered among mountain forests and discussed Buddhist principles with scholar-monks.

sentences.zh: 中年後，不食葷血，常齋戒，屏嗜欲。

translations.literal: After middle age he did not eat flesh or blood, constantly kept fasts, and barred indulgence.
translations.idiomatic: After middle age he did not eat flesh or blood, constantly kept fasts, and barred indulgence.

sentences.zh: 香爐貝典，不離齋中；

translations.literal: Incense burners and shell sutras never left his fasting chamber;
translations.idiomatic: Incense burners and shell sutras never left his fasting chamber;

sentences.zh: 詠歌贊唄，以為法樂。

translations.literal: chanting hymns and praises he made his dharma music.
translations.idiomatic: chanting hymns and praises he made his dharma music.

sentences.zh: 與尚書紇幹臯皆以法號相字。

translations.literal: He and Minister of Revenue Qian Gao styled each other by dharma names.
translations.idiomatic: He and Minister of Revenue Qian Gao styled each other by dharma names.

sentences.zh: 時人重其高潔而鄙其太過，多以詞語嘲之，休不以為忤。

translations.literal: People of the time respected his lofty purity yet scorned his excess; many mocked him in words, and Xiu did not take offense.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time respected his lofty purity yet scorned his excess; many mocked him in words, and Xiu did not take offense.

sentences.zh: 俅，字冠識，亦登進士第。

translations.literal: Qiu, styled Guanshi, also passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu, styled Guanshi, also passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 休子攴。

translations.literal: Xiu's son was Po.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu's son was Po.

sentences.zh: 楊收，字藏之，同州馮翊人。

translations.literal: Yang Shou, styled Cangzhi, was a native of Fengyi in Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shou, styled Cangzhi, was a native of Fengyi in Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自言隋越公素之後。

translations.literal: He claimed descent from Sui's Duke of Yue, Su.
translations.idiomatic: He claimed descent from Sui's Duke of Yue, Su.

sentences.zh: 高祖悟虛，應賢良制科擢第，位終朔州司馬。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Wuxu passed the Exemplary special examination and ended as Assistant Administrator of Shuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Wuxu passed the Exemplary special examination and ended as Assistant Administrator of Shuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曾祖幼烈，位終寧州司馬。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Youlie ended as Assistant Administrator of Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Youlie ended as Assistant Administrator of Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖藏器，邠州三水丞。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zangqi served as Assistant Magistrate of Sanshui in Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zangqi served as Assistant Magistrate of Sanshui in Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父遺直，位終濠州錄事參軍。

translations.literal: His father Yizhi ended as Recorder of Hao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yizhi ended as Recorder of Hao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 家世為儒，遺直客於蘇州，講學為事，因家於吳。

translations.literal: The family for generations were scholars; Yizhi lodged in Suzhou and made lecturing his occupation, thus settling the family in Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The family for generations were scholars; Yizhi lodged in Suzhou and made lecturing his occupation, thus settling the family in Wu.

sentences.zh: 遺直生四子：發、假、收、嚴。

translations.literal: Yizhi had four sons: Fa, Jia, Shou, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi had four sons: Fa, Jia, Shou, and Yan.

sentences.zh: 發，字至之，太和四年登進士第，又以書判拔萃，釋褐校書郎、湖南觀察推官，再辟西蜀從事。

translations.literal: Fa, styled Zhizhi, in the fourth year of Taihe passed the jinshi examination and also distinguished himself in document judgment; upon leaving office he was proofreader and investigating officer of the Hunan Observation Commission, and twice served in the Western Shu staff.
translations.idiomatic: Fa, styled Zhizhi, in the fourth year of Taihe passed the jinshi examination and also distinguished himself in document judgment; upon leaving office he was proofreader and investigating officer of the Hunan Observation Commission, and twice served in the Western Shu staff.

sentences.zh: 入朝為監察，轉侍御史，累遷至禮部郎中。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor, transferred Attending Censor, and was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attending Censor, transferred Attending Censor, and was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 大中三年，改左司郎中。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dazhong he was reassigned Left Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dazhong he was reassigned Left Bureau Director.

sentences.zh: 宣宗追尊順宗、憲宗等尊號，禮院奏廟中神主已題舊號，請改造及重題，詔禮官議。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong posthumously honored Emperor Shunzong, Xianzong, and others with exalted titles, the Ritual Office memorialized that spirit tablets in the temple already bore old titles and requested remaking and retitling; an edict ordered ritual officials to discuss.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong posthumously honored Emperor Shunzong, Xianzong, and others with exalted titles, the Ritual Office memorialized that spirit tablets in the temple already bore old titles and requested remaking and retitling; an edict ordered ritual officials to discuss.

sentences.zh: 發與都官郎中盧搏獻議曰：

translations.literal: Fa and Director in the Ministry of Justice Lu Bo submitted an opinion saying:
translations.idiomatic: Fa and Director in the Ministry of Justice Lu Bo submitted an opinion saying:

sentences.zh: 今議者惟引東晉重造鄭太后神主事為證。

translations.literal: Those who now discuss the matter cite only the Eastern Jin remaking of Empress Dowager Zheng's spirit tablet as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: Those who now discuss the matter cite only the Eastern Jin remaking of Empress Dowager Zheng's spirit tablet as evidence.

sentences.zh: 伏以鄭太后本瑯邪王妃，薨後已祔瑯邪邸廟。

translations.literal: Consider that Empress Dowager Zheng was originally consort of the Prince of Langye; after her death she was already enshrined in the Langye mansion temple.
translations.idiomatic: Consider that Empress Dowager Zheng was originally consort of the Prince of Langye; after her death she was already enshrined in the Langye mansion temple.

sentences.zh: 其後，母以子貴，將升祔太廟。

translations.literal: Later, because the mother rose through the son's honor, she was to be elevated and enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because the mother rose through the son's honor, she was to be elevated and enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 賀循請重造新主，改題皇后之號，備禮告祔，當時用之。

translations.literal: He Xun requested remaking a new tablet and changing the inscription to the title of empress, performing full rites to announce enshrinement; it was used at the time.
translations.idiomatic: He Xun requested remaking a new tablet and changing the inscription to the title of empress, performing full rites to announce enshrinement; it was used at the time.

sentences.zh: 伏以諸侯廟主與天子廟主長短不同。

translations.literal: Consider that feudal temple tablets and Son-of-Heaven temple tablets differ in length.
translations.idiomatic: Consider that feudal temple tablets and Son-of-Heaven temple tablets differ in length.

sentences.zh: 若以王妃八寸之主上配至極，禮似不同。

translations.literal: If an eight-inch consort tablet is matched to the utmost pinnacle, the ritual seems unlike.
translations.idiomatic: If an eight-inch consort tablet is matched to the utmost pinnacle, the ritual seems unlike.

sentences.zh: 時諂神貪君之私，用此謬禮，改造神主。

translations.literal: At the time flatterers of spirits and greedy for the ruler's favor used this erroneous ritual and remade the spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: At the time flatterers of spirits and greedy for the ruler's favor used this erroneous ritual and remade the spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 比量晉事，又絕非宜。

translations.literal: Comparing it with the Jin affair, it is again by no means fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Comparing it with the Jin affair, it is again by no means fitting.

sentences.zh: 且宣懿非穆宗之後，實武宗之母。

translations.literal: Moreover Empress Dowager Xuanyi was not a descendant of Emperor Muzong but was in fact Emperor Wuzong's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Empress Dowager Xuanyi was not a descendant of Emperor Muzong but was in fact Emperor Wuzong's mother.

sentences.zh: 母以子之貴，已祔別廟，正為得禮，饗薦無虧。

translations.literal: Because the mother rose through the son's honor she was already enshrined in a separate temple—precisely obtaining ritual; offerings were not diminished.
translations.idiomatic: Because the mother rose through the son's honor she was already enshrined in a separate temple—precisely obtaining ritual; offerings were not diminished.

sentences.zh: 今若從祀至尊，題主稱為太后，因臣因子，正得其宜。

translations.literal: If she now follows in sacrificing to the utmost honored one and the tablet is titled Empress Dowager, through the minister following the son it is precisely fitting.
translations.idiomatic: If she now follows in sacrificing to the utmost honored one and the tablet is titled Empress Dowager, through the minister following the son it is precisely fitting.

sentences.zh: 今乃別造新主，題去太字，即是穆宗上仙之後，臣下追致作殯之禮，瀆亂正經，實驚有識。

translations.literal: Now to separately make a new tablet and remove the character for Grand is, after Emperor Muzong's ascension to immortality, for subordinates to pursue and perform funeral rites—defiling the correct classic and truly alarming the knowledgeable.
translations.idiomatic: Now to separately make a new tablet and remove the character for Grand is, after Emperor Muzong's ascension to immortality, for subordinates to pursue and perform funeral rites—defiling the correct classic and truly alarming the knowledgeable.

sentences.zh: 臣當時並列朝行，實知謬戾。

translations.literal: Your subjects at the time stood together in the court procession and truly knew the error.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects at the time stood together in the court procession and truly knew the error.

sentences.zh: 以漢律，擅論宗廟者以大不敬論，又其時無詔下議，遂默塞不敢出言。

translations.literal: By Han law, those who usurp discussion of the ancestral temple are judged great irreverence; moreover at the time no edict ordered discussion, so we silently blocked and dared not speak.
translations.idiomatic: By Han law, those who usurp discussion of the ancestral temple are judged great irreverence; moreover at the time no edict ordered discussion, so we silently blocked and dared not speak.

sentences.zh: 今又欲重用東晉謬禮，穢媟聖朝大典。

translations.literal: Now they again wish to reuse the Eastern Jin's erroneous ritual, defiling and insulting the holy court's great canon.
translations.idiomatic: Now they again wish to reuse the Eastern Jin's erroneous ritual, defiling and insulting the holy court's great canon.

sentences.zh: 猥蒙下問，敢不盡言。

translations.literal: We humbly receive Your inquiry and dare not speak incompletely.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly receive Your inquiry and dare not speak incompletely.

sentences.zh: 臣謹按國朝前例，甚有明文。

translations.literal: Your subjects respectfully note that Our dynasty's former precedents have very clear text.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects respectfully note that Our dynasty's former precedents have very clear text.

sentences.zh: 武德元年五月，備法駕於長安通義裏舊廟，奉迎宣簡公、懿王、景皇帝神主，升祔太廟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Wude, with full imperial equipage at the old temple in Tongyi Lane of Chang'an, spirit tablets of Duke Xuanjian, Prince Yi, and Emperor Jing were welcomed and elevated to enshrinement in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Wude, with full imperial equipage at the old temple in Tongyi Lane of Chang'an, spirit tablets of Duke Xuanjian, Prince Yi, and Emperor Jing were welcomed and elevated to enshrinement in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 既言於舊廟奉迎，足明必奉舊主。

translations.literal: Since it says welcoming from the old temple, it clearly shows old tablets must have been used.
translations.idiomatic: Since it says welcoming from the old temple, it clearly shows old tablets must have been used.

sentences.zh: 其加謚追尊之禮，自古本無其事，自則天太后攝政之後累有之。

translations.literal: The rites of adding posthumous titles and honoring exaltation—from antiquity originally there was no such affair; since Empress Dowager Wu's regency there have repeatedly been such cases.
translations.idiomatic: The rites of adding posthumous titles and honoring exaltation—from antiquity originally there was no such affair; since Empress Dowager Wu's regency there have repeatedly been such cases.

sentences.zh: 自此之後，數用其禮。

translations.literal: From then on the ritual has repeatedly been used.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the ritual has repeatedly been used.

sentences.zh: 歷檢國史，並無改造重題之文。

translations.literal: Examining the national history throughout, there is no text of remaking and retitling.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the national history throughout, there is no text of remaking and retitling.

sentences.zh: 若故事有之，無不書於簡冊。

translations.literal: If precedent existed, it would without fail be written in the bamboo slips and registers.
translations.idiomatic: If precedent existed, it would without fail be written in the bamboo slips and registers.

sentences.zh: 臣等愚見，宜但告新謚於廟而止。

translations.literal: Your subjects' humble view is that one should only announce the new posthumous title at the temple and stop.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects' humble view is that one should only announce the new posthumous title at the temple and stop.

sentences.zh: 其改造重題之文，開元初，太常卿韋縚以高宗廟題武後神主雲「天後聖帝武氏」，縚奏請削去「天後聖帝」之號，別題雲「則天順聖皇后武氏」，詔從之。

translations.literal: As for text of remaking and retitling—in the early Kaiyuan era Minister of Ceremonies Wei Zong, because Emperor Gaozong's temple tablet for Empress Wu read "Holy Emperor Wu of the Heavenly Empress," Zong memorialized requesting removal of the title "Holy Emperor of the Heavenly Empress" and separate inscription reading "Empress Wu of the Shun Sheng of Zetian," and an edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: As for text of remaking and retitling—in the early Kaiyuan era Minister of Ceremonies Wei Zong, because Emperor Gaozong's temple tablet for Empress Wu read "Holy Emperor Wu of the Heavenly Empress," Zong memorialized requesting removal of the title "Holy Emperor of the Heavenly Empress" and separate inscription reading "Empress Wu of the Shun Sheng of Zetian," and an edict followed this.

sentences.zh: 即不知其時削舊題耶？

translations.literal: Then one does not know whether at the time the old inscription was cut away?
translations.idiomatic: Then one does not know whether at the time the old inscription was cut away?

sentences.zh: 重造主耶？

translations.literal: Or a tablet was remade?
translations.idiomatic: Or a tablet was remade?

sentences.zh: 亦不知用何代典禮？

translations.literal: Nor does one know what era's ritual canon was used?
translations.idiomatic: Nor does one know what era's ritual canon was used?

sentences.zh: 禮之疑者，決在宸衷。

translations.literal: Where ritual is doubtful, the decision rests in the imperial heart.
translations.idiomatic: Where ritual is doubtful, the decision rests in the imperial heart.

sentences.zh: 以臣所見，但以新謚寶冊告陵廟，正得其宜。

translations.literal: In your subjects' view, one need only announce the new posthumous treasure text at the tomb temple—precisely obtaining fitness.
translations.idiomatic: In your subjects' view, one need only announce the new posthumous treasure text at the tomb temple—precisely obtaining fitness.

sentences.zh: 改造重題，恐乖禮意。

translations.literal: Remaking and retitling fears violating ritual intent.
translations.idiomatic: Remaking and retitling fears violating ritual intent.

sentences.zh: 時宰相覆奏就神主改題，而知禮者非之，以發議為是。

translations.literal: At the time the chief minister resubmitted retitling on the existing spirit tablet, and those who knew ritual disapproved, holding Fa's opinion correct.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the chief minister resubmitted retitling on the existing spirit tablet, and those who knew ritual disapproved, holding Fa's opinion correct.

sentences.zh: 改授太常少卿，出為蘇州刺史。

translations.literal: He was reassigned Vice Director of Ceremonies and sent out as Prefect of Su.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned Vice Director of Ceremonies and sent out as Prefect of Su.

sentences.zh: 蘇，發之鄉里也。

translations.literal: Su was Fa's native place.
translations.idiomatic: Su was Fa's native place.

sentences.zh: 恭長慈幼，人士稱之。

translations.literal: Respectful to elders and kind to the young, scholars praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Respectful to elders and kind to the young, scholars praised him.

sentences.zh: 還，改福州刺史、福建觀察使。

translations.literal: On returning he was reassigned Prefect of Fu and Fujian Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he was reassigned Prefect of Fu and Fujian Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甌閩之人，美其能政，耆老以善績聞。

translations.literal: People of Min praised his able governance; elders reported his good achievements.
translations.idiomatic: People of Min praised his able governance; elders reported his good achievements.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以發長於邊事，移授廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: The court, because Fa was skilled in frontier affairs, transferred him Prefect of Guang and Lingnan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The court, because Fa was skilled in frontier affairs, transferred him Prefect of Guang and Lingnan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 屬前政不率，蠻、夏鹹怨；

translations.literal: The previous administration did not lead properly; barbarians and Xia alike resented;
translations.idiomatic: The previous administration did not lead properly; barbarians and Xia alike resented;

sentences.zh: 發以嚴為理，軍亂，為軍人所囚，致於郵舍。

translations.literal: Fa governed with severity; the army mutinied and the soldiers imprisoned him, keeping him at the post station.
translations.idiomatic: Fa governed with severity; the army mutinied and the soldiers imprisoned him, keeping him at the post station.

sentences.zh: 坐貶婺州刺史，卒於治所。

translations.literal: He was demoted Prefect of Wu and died in his administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted Prefect of Wu and died in his administration.

sentences.zh: 子乘，亦登進士第，有俊才，尤能為歌詩，歷顯職。

translations.literal: His son was Sheng, who also passed the jinshi examination, had outstanding talent, and was especially skilled at song and poetry, passing through prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Sheng, who also passed the jinshi examination, had outstanding talent, and was especially skilled at song and poetry, passing through prominent posts.

sentences.zh: 假，字仁之，進士擢第。

translations.literal: Jia, styled Renzhi, passed the jinshi selection.
translations.idiomatic: Jia, styled Renzhi, passed the jinshi selection.

sentences.zh: 故相鄭覃刺華州，署為從事。

translations.literal: Former Chief Minister Zheng Tan governed Hua Prefecture and appointed him staff member.
translations.idiomatic: Former Chief Minister Zheng Tan governed Hua Prefecture and appointed him staff member.

sentences.zh: 從覃鎮京口，得大理評事。

translations.literal: When Tan governed Jingkou, he obtained the post of Grand Court Assessor.
