translations.idiomatic: When Tan governed Jingkou, he obtained the post of Grand Court Assessor.

sentences.zh: 入為監察，轉侍御史。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor and transferred Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attending Censor and transferred Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 由司封郎中知雜事，轉太常少卿。

translations.literal: From Director in the Ministry of Public Works with mixed duties he transferred Vice Director of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: From Director in the Ministry of Public Works with mixed duties he transferred Vice Director of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 出為常州刺史，卒官。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Prefect of Chang and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Prefect of Chang and died in office.

sentences.zh: 初，遺直娶元氏，生發、假。

translations.literal: At first Yizhi married the Yuan clan and bore Fa and Jia.
translations.idiomatic: At first Yizhi married the Yuan clan and bore Fa and Jia.

sentences.zh: 繼室長孫氏，生收、嚴。

translations.literal: The second wife of the Zhangsun clan bore Shou and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The second wife of the Zhangsun clan bore Shou and Yan.

sentences.zh: 收長六尺二寸，廣顙深頤，疏眉秀目；

translations.literal: Shou was six feet two inches tall, with broad forehead and deep chin, sparse brows and fine eyes;
translations.idiomatic: Shou was six feet two inches tall, with broad forehead and deep chin, sparse brows and fine eyes;

sentences.zh: 寡言笑，方於事上，博聞強記。

translations.literal: he spoke little and laughed little, was square in serving superiors, and was widely informed with a strong memory.
translations.idiomatic: he spoke little and laughed little, was square in serving superiors, and was widely informed with a strong memory.

sentences.zh: 初，家寄涔陽，甚貧。

translations.literal: At first the family lodged at Cenyang and was very poor.
translations.idiomatic: At first the family lodged at Cenyang and was very poor.

sentences.zh: 收七歲喪父，居喪有如成人。

translations.literal: Shou lost his father at seven; in mourning he behaved like an adult.
translations.idiomatic: Shou lost his father at seven; in mourning he behaved like an adult.

sentences.zh: 而長孫夫人知書，親自教授。

translations.literal: Lady Zhangsun knew books and personally taught him.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhangsun knew books and personally taught him.

sentences.zh: 十三，略通諸經義，善於文詠，吳人呼為「神童」。

translations.literal: At thirteen he had slight mastery of the classics' meaning and was skilled at literary composition; people of Wu called him the "Divine Child."
translations.idiomatic: At thirteen he had slight mastery of the classics' meaning and was skilled at literary composition; people of Wu called him the "Divine Child."

sentences.zh: 兄發戲令詠蛙，即曰：「兔邊分玉樹，龍底耀銅儀。

translations.literal: Elder brother Fa playfully ordered him to compose on frogs, and he at once said, "By the rabbit jade trees divide, at the dragon's base bronze vessels shine.
translations.idiomatic: Elder brother Fa playfully ordered him to compose on frogs, and he at once said, "By the rabbit jade trees divide, at the dragon's base bronze vessels shine.

sentences.zh: 會當同鼓吹，不復問官私。」

translations.literal: When the time comes we shall drum together—no longer asking public or private."
translations.idiomatic: When the time comes we shall drum together—no longer asking public or private."

sentences.zh: 又令詠筆，仍賦鉆字，即曰：「雖匪囊中物，何堅不可鉆？

translations.literal: Again he was ordered to compose on the brush and also compose on the character for drilling, and at once he said, "Though not a thing in the bag, what hardness cannot be drilled?
translations.idiomatic: Again he was ordered to compose on the brush and also compose on the character for drilling, and at once he said, "Though not a thing in the bag, what hardness cannot be drilled?

sentences.zh: 一朝操政事，定使冠三端。」

translations.literal: Once handling government affairs, it will surely make one crown the three terminals."
translations.idiomatic: Once handling government affairs, it will surely make one crown the three terminals."

sentences.zh: 每良辰美景，吳人造門觀神童，請為詩什，觀者壓敗其籓。

translations.literal: On every fine day and beautiful scene people of Wu crowded his gate to view the divine child and request poems; viewers crushed his fence.
translations.idiomatic: On every fine day and beautiful scene people of Wu crowded his gate to view the divine child and request poems; viewers crushed his fence.

sentences.zh: 收嘲曰：「爾幸無羸角，何用觸吾籓。

translations.literal: Shou mocked them, saying, "You are lucky to have no weak horns—why use them to touch my fence.
translations.idiomatic: Shou mocked them, saying, "You are lucky to have no weak horns—why use them to touch my fence.

sentences.zh: 若是升堂者，還應自得門。」

translations.literal: If you are ones who ascend the hall, you should still gain the door yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: If you are ones who ascend the hall, you should still gain the door yourselves."

sentences.zh: 收為母奉佛，幼不食肉，母亦勖之曰：「俟爾登進士第，可肉食也。」

translations.literal: Shou honored Buddhism for his mother; from youth he did not eat meat, and his mother also urged him, saying, "Wait until you pass the jinshi examination—then you may eat meat."
translations.idiomatic: Shou honored Buddhism for his mother; from youth he did not eat meat, and his mother also urged him, saying, "Wait until you pass the jinshi examination—then you may eat meat."

sentences.zh: 收以仲兄假未登第，久之不從鄉賦。

translations.literal: Because his second elder brother Jia had not yet passed the examination, Shou for a long time did not follow the local examination.
translations.idiomatic: Because his second elder brother Jia had not yet passed the examination, Shou for a long time did not follow the local examination.

sentences.zh: 開成末，假擢第；

translations.literal: At the end of Kaicheng Jia passed the selection;
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Kaicheng Jia passed the selection;

sentences.zh: 是冬，收之長安，明年，一舉登第，年才二十六。

translations.literal: that winter Shou went to Chang'an, and the next year he passed in one attempt at age twenty-six.
translations.idiomatic: that winter Shou went to Chang'an, and the next year he passed in one attempt at age twenty-six.

sentences.zh: 時發為潤州從事，因家金陵。

translations.literal: At the time Fa was staff member at Run Prefecture, thus the family settled in Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Fa was staff member at Run Prefecture, thus the family settled in Jinling.

sentences.zh: 收得第東歸，路由淮右，故相司徒杜悰鎮揚州，延收署節度推官，奏授校書郎。

translations.literal: When Shou passed the examination returning east, his route passed Huaiyou; former Chief Minister Minister of Education Du Cong governed Yang Prefecture and retained Shou as military commission investigating officer and memorialized appointment as proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: When Shou passed the examination returning east, his route passed Huaiyou; former Chief Minister Minister of Education Du Cong governed Yang Prefecture and retained Shou as military commission investigating officer and memorialized appointment as proofreader.

sentences.zh: 悰領度支，以收為巡官。

translations.literal: Cong directed the Revenue Bureau and used Shou as patrol officer.
translations.idiomatic: Cong directed the Revenue Bureau and used Shou as patrol officer.

sentences.zh: 悰罷相鎮東蜀，奏授掌書記，得協律郎。

translations.literal: When Cong was removed as chief minister and governed Eastern Shu he memorialized Shou as secretary and obtained the post of Harmonizing Law Officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong was removed as chief minister and governed Eastern Shu he memorialized Shou as secretary and obtained the post of Harmonizing Law Officer.

sentences.zh: 悰移鎮西川，復管記室。

translations.literal: When Cong moved to govern Western Chuan he again managed the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong moved to govern Western Chuan he again managed the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 宰相馬植奏授渭南尉，充集賢校理，改監察御史。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Ma Zhi memorialized appointment as Assistant Magistrate of Weinan and Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, reassigned Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Ma Zhi memorialized appointment as Assistant Magistrate of Weinan and Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, reassigned Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 收辭曰：「仆兄弟進退以義。

translations.literal: Shou declined, saying, "We servants, brothers, advance and retreat by righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Shou declined, saying, "We servants, brothers, advance and retreat by righteousness.

sentences.zh: 頃仲兄假鄉賦未第，收不出衡門。

translations.literal: Recently my second elder brother Jia's local examination did not pass; Shou did not leave his door.
translations.idiomatic: Recently my second elder brother Jia's local examination did not pass; Shou did not leave his door.

sentences.zh: 今假從事侯府，仆不忍先為御史。

translations.literal: Now Jia serves in a marquis's headquarters; Shou cannot bear to become censor first.
translations.idiomatic: Now Jia serves in a marquis's headquarters; Shou cannot bear to become censor first.

sentences.zh: 相公必欲振恤孤生，俟仆稟兄旨命可也。」

translations.literal: If the Chief Minister must uplift this orphaned life, wait until Shou receives elder brother's command."
translations.idiomatic: If the Chief Minister must uplift this orphaned life, wait until Shou receives elder brother's command."

sentences.zh: 馬公嘉之。

translations.literal: Lord Ma praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ma praised this.

sentences.zh: 收即密達意於西蜀杜公，願復為參佐，悰即表為節度判官。

translations.literal: Shou at once secretly conveyed his intent to Lord Du in Western Shu, wishing again to serve as aide; Cong immediately memorialized him as military commission judge.
translations.idiomatic: Shou at once secretly conveyed his intent to Lord Du in Western Shu, wishing again to serve as aide; Cong immediately memorialized him as military commission judge.

sentences.zh: 馬公乃以收弟嚴為渭南尉、集賢校理，代收之任。

translations.literal: Lord Ma then appointed Shou's younger brother Yan Assistant Magistrate of Weinan and Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, replacing Shou's duties.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ma then appointed Shou's younger brother Yan Assistant Magistrate of Weinan and Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, replacing Shou's duties.

sentences.zh: 周墀罷相，鎮東蜀，表嚴為掌書記。

translations.literal: When Zhou Chi was removed as chief minister and governed Eastern Shu he memorialized Yan as secretary.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Chi was removed as chief minister and governed Eastern Shu he memorialized Yan as secretary.

sentences.zh: 墀至鎮而卒，悰乃辟嚴為觀察判官。

translations.literal: When Chi reached his command he died; Cong then summoned Yan as observation commission judge.
translations.idiomatic: When Chi reached his command he died; Cong then summoned Yan as observation commission judge.

sentences.zh: 兄弟同幕，為兩使判官，時人榮之。

translations.literal: The brothers served together on staff as judges for two commissioners; people of the time honored them.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers served together on staff as judges for two commissioners; people of the time honored them.

sentences.zh: 俄而假自浙西觀察判官入為監察御史，收亦自西川入為監察。

translations.literal: Soon Jia entered from Western Zhe observation commission judge as Attending Censor, and Shou also entered from Western Chuan as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jia entered from Western Zhe observation commission judge as Attending Censor, and Shou also entered from Western Chuan as Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 兄弟並居憲府，特為新例。

translations.literal: The brothers both stood in the censorate—a special new case.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers both stood in the censorate—a special new case.

sentences.zh: 裴休作相，以收深於禮學，用為太常博士。

translations.literal: When Pei Xiu became chief minister, because Shou was deep in ritual learning he was used as Erudite of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: When Pei Xiu became chief minister, because Shou was deep in ritual learning he was used as Erudite of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 時收弟嚴亦自揚州從事入為監察。

translations.literal: At the time Shou's younger brother Yan also entered from Yang Prefecture staff as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Shou's younger brother Yan also entered from Yang Prefecture staff as Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 尋丁母喪，歸蘇州。

translations.literal: Soon he entered mourning for his mother and returned to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered mourning for his mother and returned to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 既除，崔珙罷相，鎮淮南，以收為觀察支使。

translations.literal: When mourning ended Cui Gong was removed as chief minister and governed Huainan; Shou was used as observation commission paymaster.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended Cui Gong was removed as chief minister and governed Huainan; Shou was used as observation commission paymaster.

sentences.zh: 入為侍御史，改職方員外郎，分司東都。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor, reassigned Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War, and served in the Eastern Capital branch.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attending Censor, reassigned Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War, and served in the Eastern Capital branch.

sentences.zh: 宰相夏侯孜領度支，用收為判官。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Xiahou Zi directed the Revenue Bureau and used Shou as judge.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Xiahou Zi directed the Revenue Bureau and used Shou as judge.

sentences.zh: 罷職，改司勛員外郎、長安令。

translations.literal: When dismissed from duty he was reassigned Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War and Magistrate of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When dismissed from duty he was reassigned Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War and Magistrate of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，改吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: When his term ended he was reassigned Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he was reassigned Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 上言先人未葬，旅殯毗陵，擬遷卜於河南之偃師，請兄弟自往。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial that his forebears were not yet buried and lay in temporary coffins at Biling; he planned to move burial to Yanshi in Henan and requested that the brothers go in person.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial that his forebears were not yet buried and lay in temporary coffins at Biling; he planned to move burial to Yanshi in Henan and requested that the brothers go in person.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 及葬，東周會葬者千人。

translations.literal: At the burial more than a thousand people from eastern Zhou came to the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: At the burial more than a thousand people from eastern Zhou came to the funeral.

sentences.zh: 時故府杜悰、夏侯孜皆在洛，二公聯薦收於執政。

translations.literal: At the time former headquarters lords Du Cong and Xiahou Zi were both in Luoyang; the two lords jointly recommended Shou to those in power.
translations.idiomatic: At the time former headquarters lords Du Cong and Xiahou Zi were both in Luoyang; the two lords jointly recommended Shou to those in power.

sentences.zh: 宰相令狐綯用收為翰林學士，以庫部郎中知制誥，正拜中書舍人，賜金紫，轉兵部侍郎、學士承旨。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Linghu Tao used Shou as Hanlin Academician, with Director in the Treasury as Drafting Officer for Proclamations, formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, granted gold and purple, transferred Vice Minister of War and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Linghu Tao used Shou as Hanlin Academician, with Director in the Treasury as Drafting Officer for Proclamations, formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, granted gold and purple, transferred Vice Minister of War and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 左軍中尉楊玄價以收宗姓，深左右之，乃加銀青光祿大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事，累遷門下侍郎、刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Left Army Chief Eunuch Yang Xuanjia, because Shou shared the clan surname, deeply supported him; he was added Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Associate Chief Minister, and repeatedly promoted Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Left Army Chief Eunuch Yang Xuanjia, because Shou shared the clan surname, deeply supported him; he was added Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Associate Chief Minister, and repeatedly promoted Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 收以交址未復，南蠻擾亂，請治軍江西，以壯出嶺之師。

translations.literal: Because Jiaozhi was not yet recovered and southern barbarians disturbed order, Shou requested organizing an army in Jiangxi to strengthen the force crossing the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: Because Jiaozhi was not yet recovered and southern barbarians disturbed order, Shou requested organizing an army in Jiangxi to strengthen the force crossing the ranges.

sentences.zh: 乃於洪州置鎮南軍，屯兵積粟，以餉南海。

translations.literal: Then at Hong Prefecture the Zhennan Army was established, troops were stationed and grain accumulated to supply the Southern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Then at Hong Prefecture the Zhennan Army was established, troops were stationed and grain accumulated to supply the Southern Sea.

sentences.zh: 天子嘉之，進位尚書右僕射、太清太微宮使、弘文館大學士、晉陽縣男、食邑三百戶。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven praised this and promoted him Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Commissioner of the Great Pure and Great Micro Palaces, Grand Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture, Baron of Jinyang with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven praised this and promoted him Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Commissioner of the Great Pure and Great Micro Palaces, Grand Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture, Baron of Jinyang with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 收居位稍務華靡，頗為名輩所譏。

translations.literal: In office Shou gradually pursued splendor and was much ridiculed by famous contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: In office Shou gradually pursued splendor and was much ridiculed by famous contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 而門吏僮奴，倚為奸利。

translations.literal: Yet gate clerks and servant boys relied on him for wicked profit.
translations.idiomatic: Yet gate clerks and servant boys relied on him for wicked profit.

sentences.zh: 時楊玄價弟兄掌機務，招來方鎮之賂，屢有請托，收不能盡從。

translations.literal: At the time Yang Xuanjia's brothers controlled critical affairs and solicited bribes from regional commands; there were repeated requests, and Shou could not fully comply.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yang Xuanjia's brothers controlled critical affairs and solicited bribes from regional commands; there were repeated requests, and Shou could not fully comply.

sentences.zh: 玄價以為背己，由是傾之。

translations.literal: Xuanjia thought this betrayed himself and therefore undermined him.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanjia thought this betrayed himself and therefore undermined him.

sentences.zh: 八年十月，罷知政事，檢校工部尚書，出為宣歙觀察使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighth year he was removed from governing affairs, appointed Acting Minister of Public Works, and sent out as Xuanchen Observer.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year he was removed from governing affairs, appointed Acting Minister of Public Works, and sent out as Xuanchen Observer.

sentences.zh: 韋保衡作相，又發收陰事，言前用嚴譔為江西節度，納賂百萬。

translations.literal: When Wei Baoheng became chief minister he again exposed Shou's secret affairs, saying that earlier he had used Yan Zan as Jiangxi Military Commissioner and accepted a bribe of one million.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei Baoheng became chief minister he again exposed Shou's secret affairs, saying that earlier he had used Yan Zan as Jiangxi Military Commissioner and accepted a bribe of one million.

sentences.zh: 明年八月，貶為端州司馬，尋盡削官封，長流驩州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the next year he was demoted Assistant Administrator of Duan and soon stripped of all offices and titles and exiled far to Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the next year he was demoted Assistant Administrator of Duan and soon stripped of all offices and titles and exiled far to Huan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又令內養郭全穆賫詔賜死。

translations.literal: He was also ordered that Inner Attendant Guo Quanmu carry an edict granting death.
translations.idiomatic: He was also ordered that Inner Attendant Guo Quanmu carry an edict granting death.

sentences.zh: 九年三月十五日，全穆追及之，宣詔訖，收謂全穆曰：「收為宰相無狀，得死為幸。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the third month of the ninth year Quanmu overtook him; when the edict was proclaimed Shou told Quanmu, "Shou as chief minister was worthless; to obtain death is fortune.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day of the third month of the ninth year Quanmu overtook him; when the edict was proclaimed Shou told Quanmu, "Shou as chief minister was worthless; to obtain death is fortune.

sentences.zh: 心所悲者，弟兄淪喪將盡，只有弟嚴一人，以奉先人之祀。

translations.literal: What my heart grieves is that my brothers are nearly all ruined; only younger brother Yan remains to serve our forefathers' sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: What my heart grieves is that my brothers are nearly all ruined; only younger brother Yan remains to serve our forefathers' sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 予欲昧死上塵天聽，可容一刻之命，以俟秉筆乎？」

translations.literal: I wish, risking death, to dust the heavenly hearing—may I have a moment's life to await the brush?"
translations.idiomatic: I wish, risking death, to dust the heavenly hearing—may I have a moment's life to await the brush?"

sentences.zh: 全穆許之。

translations.literal: Quanmu permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Quanmu permitted it.

sentences.zh: 收自書曰：

translations.literal: Shou wrote himself:
translations.idiomatic: Shou wrote himself:

sentences.zh: 全穆復奏，懿崇湣然宥嚴。

translations.literal: Quanmu resubmitted and Emperor Yizong was moved and pardoned Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Quanmu resubmitted and Emperor Yizong was moved and pardoned Yan.

sentences.zh: 判官朱侃、常潾、閻均，族人楊公慶、嚴季實、楊全益、何師玄、李孟勛、馬全祐、李羽、王彥復等，皆配流嶺表。

translations.literal: Secretaries Zhu Kan, Chang Lin, and Yan Jun, clansmen Yang Gongqing, Yan Jishi, Yang Quanyi, He Shixuan, Li Mengxun, Ma Quanyou, Li Yu, Wang Yanfu, and others were all sent to exile beyond the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: Secretaries Zhu Kan, Chang Lin, and Yan Jun, clansmen Yang Gongqing, Yan Jishi, Yang Quanyi, He Shixuan, Li Mengxun, Ma Quanyou, Li Yu, Wang Yanfu, and others were all sent to exile beyond the ranges.

sentences.zh: 收子鑒、鉅、鏻，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: Shou's sons Jian, Ju, and Lin all passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Shou's sons Jian, Ju, and Lin all passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 鉅，乾寧初以尚書郎知制誥，召充翰林學士，拜中書舍人、戶部侍郎，封晉陽男、食邑三百戶。

translations.literal: Ju, at the beginning of Qianning as Director in the Ministry of Revenue directed proclamations, was summoned Hanlin Academician, appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue, enfeoffed Baron of Jinyang with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Ju, at the beginning of Qianning as Director in the Ministry of Revenue directed proclamations, was summoned Hanlin Academician, appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue, enfeoffed Baron of Jinyang with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 從昭宗東遷，為左散騎常侍，卒。

translations.literal: Following Emperor Zhaozong east he served as Left Regular Attendant and died.
translations.idiomatic: Following Emperor Zhaozong east he served as Left Regular Attendant and died.

sentences.zh: 鏻，登第後補集賢校理，藍田尉。

translations.literal: Lin, after passing the examination supplemented Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and Assistant Magistrate of Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: Lin, after passing the examination supplemented Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and Assistant Magistrate of Lantian.

sentences.zh: 乾寧中，累遷尚書郎。

translations.literal: In the Qianning era he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianning era he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 嚴，字凜之，會昌四年進士擢第。

translations.literal: Yan, styled Linzhi, in the fourth year of Huichang passed the jinshi selection.
translations.idiomatic: Yan, styled Linzhi, in the fourth year of Huichang passed the jinshi selection.

sentences.zh: 是歲僕射王起典貢部，選士三十人，嚴與楊知至、竇緘、源重、鄭樸五人試文合格，物議以子弟非之，起覆奏。

translations.literal: That year Vice Director Wang Qi presided over the examination department and selected thirty candidates; Yan with Yang Zhizhi, Dou Jian, Yuan Zhong, and Zheng Pu passed the literary test; public opinion criticized them as sons of officials; Qi resubmitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year Vice Director Wang Qi presided over the examination department and selected thirty candidates; Yan with Yang Zhizhi, Dou Jian, Yuan Zhong, and Zheng Pu passed the literary test; public opinion criticized them as sons of officials; Qi resubmitted.

sentences.zh: 武宗敕曰：「楊嚴一人可及第，余四人落下。」

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong's edict read: "Yang Yan alone may pass; the other four are rejected."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong's edict read, "Yang Yan alone may pass; the other four are rejected."

sentences.zh: 嚴釋褐諸侯府。

translations.literal: Yan left office in feudal headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Yan left office in feudal headquarters.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，累遷吏部員外，轉郎中，拜給事中、工部侍郎，尋以本官充翰林學士。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he was repeatedly promoted to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Personnel, transferred Director, appointed Supervising Censor and Vice Minister of Public Works, and soon with his existing office served as Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era he was repeatedly promoted to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Personnel, transferred Director, appointed Supervising Censor and Vice Minister of Public Works, and soon with his existing office served as Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 兄收作相，封章請外職，拜越州刺史、御史中丞、浙東團練觀察使。

translations.literal: When elder brother Shou became chief minister he submitted sealed memorial requesting an outer post and was appointed Prefect of Yue, Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong Training-and-Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When elder brother Shou became chief minister he submitted sealed memorial requesting an outer post and was appointed Prefect of Yue, Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong Training-and-Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 收罷相貶官，嚴坐貶邵州刺史。

translations.literal: When Shou was removed as chief minister and demoted, Yan was implicated and demoted Prefect of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: When Shou was removed as chief minister and demoted, Yan was implicated and demoted Prefect of Shao.

sentences.zh: 收得雪，嚴量移吉王傅。

translations.literal: When Shou was cleared Yan was transferred in measure to Tutor of the Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: When Shou was cleared Yan was transferred in measure to Tutor of the Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 乾符四年，累遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianfu he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qianfu he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 五年，判度支。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he directed the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he directed the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 其年病卒。

translations.literal: That year he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 二子：涉、注。

translations.literal: Two sons: She and Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons: She and Zhu.

sentences.zh: 涉，乾符二年登進士第。

translations.literal: She, in the second year of Qianfu passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: She, in the second year of Qianfu passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 昭宗朝，累遷吏部郎中、禮、刑二侍郎。

translations.literal: In the Zhaozong court he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Personnel and Vice Minister of Rites and Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhaozong court he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Personnel and Vice Minister of Rites and Justice.

sentences.zh: 乾符四年，改吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianfu he was reassigned Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qianfu he was reassigned Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 天祐初，轉左丞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou he was transferred Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianyou he was transferred Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 從昭宗遷洛陽，改吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Following Emperor Zhaozong to Luoyang he was reassigned Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Following Emperor Zhaozong to Luoyang he was reassigned Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 輝王即位，本官平章事，加中書侍郎。

translations.literal: When Prince Hui acceded, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and was added Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Hui acceded, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and was added Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 涉性端厚秉禮。

translations.literal: She was upright, thick, and observant of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: She was upright, thick, and observant of ritual.

sentences.zh: 乾寧之後，賊臣竊發，王室浸微。

translations.literal: After Qianning treacherous ministers arose and the royal house gradually declined.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianning treacherous ministers arose and the royal house gradually declined.

sentences.zh: 及天祐東遷，大事去矣。

translations.literal: When Tianyou moved east the great affair was lost.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianyou moved east the great affair was lost.

sentences.zh: 涉為時所嬰，不能自退。

translations.literal: She was bound by the times and could not withdraw himself.
translations.idiomatic: She was bound by the times and could not withdraw himself.

sentences.zh: 及命相之日，與家人相向灑泣曰：「吾不能脫此網羅，禍將至矣。」

translations.literal: On the day he was appointed chief minister he faced his family weeping together, saying, "I cannot escape this net; calamity will soon arrive."
translations.idiomatic: On the day he was appointed chief minister he faced his family weeping together, saying, "I cannot escape this net; calamity will soon arrive."

sentences.zh: 謂其子凝式曰：「今日之命，吾家重不幸矣，必累爾等。」

translations.literal: He told his son Ningshi, "Today's appointment is heavy misfortune for our family; it will surely implicate you all."
translations.idiomatic: He told his son Ningshi, "Today's appointment is heavy misfortune for our family; it will surely implicate you all."

sentences.zh: 涉謙退善處，竟以令終。

translations.literal: She was modest and good at comportment and in the end had a good end.
translations.idiomatic: She was modest and good at comportment and in the end had a good end.

sentences.zh: 注，中和二年進士登第。

translations.literal: Zhu, in the second year of Zhonghe passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu, in the second year of Zhonghe passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 昭宗朝，累官考功員外、刑部郎中。

translations.literal: In the Zhaozong court he rose repeatedly to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Personnel and Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhaozong court he rose repeatedly to Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Personnel and Director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 尋知制誥，正拜中書舍人，召充翰林學士，累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he directed proclamations, was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, summoned Hanlin Academician, and repeatedly promoted Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he directed proclamations, was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, summoned Hanlin Academician, and repeatedly promoted Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 輝王纘歷，兄涉為宰相，注避嫌辭內職，守戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Prince Hui succeeded the throne and elder brother She was chief minister, Zhu avoided suspicion and resigned inner duties, serving as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Hui succeeded the throne and elder brother She was chief minister, Zhu avoided suspicion and resigned inner duties, serving as Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 韋保衡者，字蘊用，京兆人。

translations.literal: Wei Baoheng, styled Yunyong, was a native of the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Baoheng, styled Yunyong, was a native of the capital district.

sentences.zh: 祖元貞，父愨，皆進士登第。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuanzhen and father Que both passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuanzhen and father Que both passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 愨，字端士，太和初登第，後累佐使府，入朝亟歷臺閣。

translations.literal: Que, styled Duanshi, at the beginning of Taihe passed the examination and later repeatedly served in headquarters and entered court, quickly passing through the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Que, styled Duanshi, at the beginning of Taihe passed the examination and later repeatedly served in headquarters and entered court, quickly passing through the censorate.

sentences.zh: 大中四年，拜禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dazhong he was appointed Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dazhong he was appointed Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 五年選士，頗得名人，載領方鎮節度，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he selected candidates and obtained many famous men; he also served as regional military commissioner and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he selected candidates and obtained many famous men; he also served as regional military commissioner and died.

sentences.zh: 保衡，咸通五年登進士第，累拜起居郎。

translations.literal: Baoheng, in the fifth year of Xiantong passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly appointed Attendant of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Baoheng, in the fifth year of Xiantong passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly appointed Attendant of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，尚懿宗女同昌公主。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year he married Emperor Yizong's daughter, Princess Tongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year he married Emperor Yizong's daughter, Princess Tongchang.

sentences.zh: 公主郭淑妃所生，妃有寵，出降之日，傾宮中珍玩以為贈送之資。

translations.literal: The princess was born to Consort Guo Shufei; the consort was favored, and on the day of the marriage the palace's precious curios were emptied as dowry gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The princess was born to Consort Guo Shufei; the consort was favored, and on the day of the marriage the palace's precious curios were emptied as dowry gifts.

sentences.zh: 尋以保衡為翰林學士，轉郎中，正拜中書舍人、兵部侍郎，承旨。

translations.literal: Soon Baoheng was made Hanlin Academician, transferred Director, formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of War, and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Baoheng was made Hanlin Academician, transferred Director, formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of War, and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 不期年，以本官平章事。

translations.literal: Within less than a year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Within less than a year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister.

sentences.zh: 保衡恃恩權，素所不悅者，必加排斥。

translations.literal: Baoheng relied on favor and power; those he disliked he always excluded.
translations.idiomatic: Baoheng relied on favor and power; those he disliked he always excluded.

sentences.zh: 王鐸貢舉之師，蕭遘同門生，以素薄其為人，皆擯斥之。

translations.literal: Wang Duo was his examination teacher and Xiao Zui his fellow student; because he had always thought little of them as men, he excluded them both.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Duo was his examination teacher and Xiao Zui his fellow student; because he had always thought little of them as men, he excluded them both.

sentences.zh: 以楊收、路巖在中書不加禮接，媒孽逐之。

translations.literal: Because Yang Shou and Lu Yan were in the Secretariat and did not show him courtesy, he slandered and drove them away.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yang Shou and Lu Yan were in the Secretariat and did not show him courtesy, he slandered and drove them away.

sentences.zh: 自起居郎至宰相，二年之間，階至特進、扶風縣開國侯、食邑二千戶、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: From Attendant of the Palace Secretariat to chief minister, within two years his rank rose to Special Advancement, Marquis of Fufeng with a fief of two thousand households, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: From Attendant of the Palace Secretariat to chief minister, within two years his rank rose to Special Advancement, Marquis of Fufeng with a fief of two thousand households, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 十一年八月，公主薨，自後恩禮漸薄。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eleventh year the princess died; thereafter favor gradually thinned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eleventh year the princess died; thereafter favor gradually thinned.

sentences.zh: 咸通末，淮、徐盜起，素所怨者發其陰事，保衡竟得罪賜死。

translations.literal: At the end of Xiantong, when Huai and Xu bandits arose, those he had long resented exposed his secret affairs and Baoheng in the end was condemned and ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xiantong, when Huai and Xu bandits arose, those he had long resented exposed his secret affairs and Baoheng in the end was condemned and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 弟保乂，進士登第，尚書郎、知制誥，召充翰林學士，歷禮、戶、兵三侍郎、學士承旨。

translations.literal: Younger brother Baoyi passed the jinshi examination, served Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, was summoned Hanlin Academician, and passed through Vice Ministers of Rites, Revenue, and War and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Baoyi passed the jinshi examination, served Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, was summoned Hanlin Academician, and passed through Vice Ministers of Rites, Revenue, and War and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 坐保衡免官。

translations.literal: Because of Baoheng he was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Baoheng he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 路巖者，字魯瞻，陽平寇氏人也。

translations.literal: Lu Yan, styled Luzhan, was a native of the Kou clan of Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yan, styled Luzhan, was a native of the Kou clan of Yangping.

sentences.zh: 祖季登，大歷六年登進士第，累辟諸侯府。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jideng, in the sixth year of Dali passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly summoned to feudal headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jideng, in the sixth year of Dali passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly summoned to feudal headquarters.

sentences.zh: 升朝為尚書郎，遷左諫議大夫，卒。

translations.literal: He entered court as Director in the Ministry of Revenue, was transferred Left Remonstrator, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Director in the Ministry of Revenue, was transferred Left Remonstrator, and died.

sentences.zh: 生三子，群、庠、單，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: He had three sons—Qun, Xiang, and Shan—all of whom passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons—Qun, Xiang, and Shan—all of whom passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 群，字正夫，既擢進士，又書判拔萃，累佐使府。

translations.literal: Qun, styled Zhengfu, having passed the jinshi also distinguished himself in document judgment and repeatedly served in headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Qun, styled Zhengfu, having passed the jinshi also distinguished himself in document judgment and repeatedly served in headquarters.

sentences.zh: 入朝為監察御史。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 穆宗初即位，遣使西北邊犒宴軍士，稱旨，累加兵部郎中。

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong first acceded he was sent as envoy to feast frontier soldiers in the northwest and pleased the emperor; he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong first acceded he was sent as envoy to feast frontier soldiers in the northwest and pleased the emperor; he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 太和二年，遷諫議大夫，以本官充侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taihe he was transferred Remonstrator and with his existing office served as Lecturer-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taihe he was transferred Remonstrator and with his existing office served as Lecturer-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 四年，罷侍講為翰林學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was removed as lecturer and made Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was removed as lecturer and made Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 五年，正拜中書舍人，學士如故。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, continuing as academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, continuing as academician.

sentences.zh: 群精經學，善屬文。

translations.literal: Qun was skilled in classical learning and good at composing prose.
translations.idiomatic: Qun was skilled in classical learning and good at composing prose.

sentences.zh: 性仁孝，誌行貞潔。

translations.literal: By nature he was benevolent and filial, his will and conduct pure.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was benevolent and filial, his will and conduct pure.

sentences.zh: 父母歿後，終身不茹葷血。

translations.literal: After his parents died he never ate flesh or blood for the rest of his life.
translations.idiomatic: After his parents died he never ate flesh or blood for the rest of his life.

sentences.zh: 歷踐臺閣，受時君異寵，未嘗以勢位自矜。

translations.literal: Passing through the censorate he received the contemporary ruler's special favor and never prided himself on power and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through the censorate he received the contemporary ruler's special favor and never prided himself on power and rank.

sentences.zh: 與士友結交，榮達如一。

translations.literal: In befriending scholars and friends he treated honor and success the same.
translations.idiomatic: In befriending scholars and friends he treated honor and success the same.

sentences.zh: 八年正月病卒，君子惜之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year he died of illness; gentlemen regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year he died of illness; gentlemen regretted it.

sentences.zh: 二子：嶽、巖，大中中相次進士登第。

translations.literal: Two sons: Yue and Yan, who in Dazhong successively passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons: Yue and Yan, who in Dazhong successively passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 巖，幼聰敏過人，父友踐方鎮，書幣交辟，久之方就。

translations.literal: Yan from youth was clever beyond others; his father's friends who served as regional commissioners repeatedly sent letters summoning him, and only after a long time did he go.
translations.idiomatic: Yan from youth was clever beyond others; his father's friends who served as regional commissioners repeatedly sent letters summoning him, and only after a long time did he go.

sentences.zh: 數年之間，出入禁署。

translations.literal: Within several years he entered and left the forbidden secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Within several years he entered and left the forbidden secretariat.

sentences.zh: 累遷中書舍人、戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 咸通三年，以本官同平章事，年始三十六。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xiantong, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister at age thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xiantong, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister at age thirty-six.

sentences.zh: 在相位八年，累兼左僕射。

translations.literal: In the chief-minister position eight years he was repeatedly concurrent Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the chief-minister position eight years he was repeatedly concurrent Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 懿宗時，王政多僻，宰臣用事。

translations.literal: In Emperor Yizong's time royal governance was often perverse and chief ministers wielded power.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Yizong's time royal governance was often perverse and chief ministers wielded power.

sentences.zh: 巖既承委遇，稍務奢靡，頗通賂遺。

translations.literal: Yan, having received entrusted favor, gradually pursued extravagance and quite trafficked in bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Yan, having received entrusted favor, gradually pursued extravagance and quite trafficked in bribes.

sentences.zh: 及韋保衡尚公主，素惡巖為人。

translations.literal: When Wei Baoheng married the princess he had always disliked Yan as a man.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei Baoheng married the princess he had always disliked Yan as a man.

sentences.zh: 保衡作相，罷巖知政事，以檢校左僕射出為成都尹、劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: When Baoheng became chief minister he removed Yan from governing affairs and sent him out as Acting Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Chief of Chengdu, and Western Chuan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Baoheng became chief minister he removed Yan from governing affairs and sent him out as Acting Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Chief of Chengdu, and Western Chuan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改荊南節度。

translations.literal: Before long he was reassigned Jingnan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was reassigned Jingnan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔令六月下峽赴鎮，尋復罷之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to leave the gorges in the sixth month and proceed to his command; soon he was again removed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to leave the gorges in the sixth month and proceed to his command; soon he was again removed.

sentences.zh: 嶽，歷兩郡刺史，入為給事中。

translations.literal: Yue served successively as prefect of two prefectures and entered court as Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Yue served successively as prefect of two prefectures and entered court as Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 子德延。

translations.literal: His son was Deyan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Deyan.

sentences.zh: 夏侯孜，字好學，本譙人。

translations.literal: Xiahou Zi, styled Haoxue, was originally from Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Xiahou Zi, styled Haoxue, was originally from Qiao.

sentences.zh: 父審封。

translations.literal: His father was Shenfeng.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Shenfeng.

sentences.zh: 孜，寶歷二年登進士第，釋褐諸侯府，累遷婺、絳二郡刺史。

translations.literal: Zi, in the second year of Baoli passed the jinshi examination, left office in feudal headquarters, and was repeatedly promoted Prefect of Wu and Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zi, in the second year of Baoli passed the jinshi examination, left office in feudal headquarters, and was repeatedly promoted Prefect of Wu and Jiang.

sentences.zh: 入為諫議大夫，轉給事中。

translations.literal: He entered court as Remonstrator and transferred Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Remonstrator and transferred Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 十年，改刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was reassigned Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was reassigned Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 十一年，兼御史中丞，遷尚書右丞、上柱國，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was concurrent Censor-in-Chief, transferred Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Pillar of State, and granted the purple-gold fish pouch.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was concurrent Censor-in-Chief, transferred Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Pillar of State, and granted the purple-gold fish pouch.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，遷朝議大夫，守戶部侍郎，判戶部事。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year he was transferred Grand Master of the Court for Discussion, serving as Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of Revenue Bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year he was transferred Grand Master of the Court for Discussion, serving as Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of Revenue Bureau affairs.

sentences.zh: 再加兵部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: He was again added Vice Minister of War and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He was again added Vice Minister of War and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.

sentences.zh: 懿宗即位，以本官同平章事，領使如故。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yizong acceded, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and continued as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yizong acceded, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and continued as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 累加左僕射、門下侍郎，封譙郡侯，與路巖、楊收同輔政。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly added Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Vice Director of the Secretariat and enfeoffed Marquis of Qiao; with Lu Yan and Yang Shou he jointly assisted governance.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly added Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Vice Director of the Secretariat and enfeoffed Marquis of Qiao; with Lu Yan and Yang Shou he jointly assisted governance.

sentences.zh: 咸通八年，罷相，檢校司空、同平章事，兼成都尹，充劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xiantong he was removed as chief minister, appointed Acting Minister of Works and Associate Chief Minister, concurrent Chief of Chengdu, and Western Chuan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xiantong he was removed as chief minister, appointed Acting Minister of Works and Associate Chief Minister, concurrent Chief of Chengdu, and Western Chuan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 屬南蠻入寇，蜀中饑饉，軍儲不備，蠻陷巂州，蜀川大擾。

translations.literal: When southern barbarians invaded, Shu suffered famine and military stores were not prepared; the barbarians captured Xi Prefecture and the Sichuan region was greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: When southern barbarians invaded, Shu suffered famine and military stores were not prepared; the barbarians captured Xi Prefecture and the Sichuan region was greatly disturbed.

sentences.zh: 尋移孜為河中尹、檢校司徒、河中晉絳節度使。

translations.literal: Soon Zi was transferred Chief of Hezhong, Acting Minister of Education, and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zi was transferred Chief of Hezhong, Acting Minister of Education, and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九年，龐勛據徐州，南蠻深入。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Pang Xun held Xu Prefecture and southern barbarians penetrated deeply.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Pang Xun held Xu Prefecture and southern barbarians penetrated deeply.

sentences.zh: 天子懲孜治蜀無政，詔曰：

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, reproaching Zi for governing Shu without effective policy, issued an edict saying:
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven, reproaching Zi for governing Shu without effective policy, issued an edict saying:

sentences.zh: 未幾卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 子潭、澤，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: His sons Tan and Ze both passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Tan and Ze both passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 潭，累官至禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Tan rose repeatedly to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Tan rose repeatedly to Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 中和三年選士，多至卿相。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhonghe he selected candidates; many rose to chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhonghe he selected candidates; many rose to chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 子坦。

translations.literal: His son was Tan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Tan.

sentences.zh: 劉瞻，字幾之，彭城人。

translations.literal: Liu Zhan, styled Jizhi, was a native of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhan, styled Jizhi, was a native of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 祖升，父景。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Sheng and his father Jing.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Sheng and his father Jing.

sentences.zh: 瞻，太和初進士擢第。

translations.literal: Zhan, at the beginning of Taihe passed the jinshi selection.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan, at the beginning of Taihe passed the jinshi selection.

sentences.zh: 四年，又登博學宏詞科，歷佐使府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he also passed the Broad Learning and Grand Words examination and repeatedly served in headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he also passed the Broad Learning and Grand Words examination and repeatedly served in headquarters.

sentences.zh: 咸通初升朝，累遷太常博士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiantong he entered court and was repeatedly promoted to Erudite of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiantong he entered court and was repeatedly promoted to Erudite of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 劉瑑作相，以宗人遇之，薦為翰林學士。

translations.literal: When Liu Zhuan became chief minister he treated him as a clansman and recommended him Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zhuan became chief minister he treated him as a clansman and recommended him Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 轉員外郎中，正拜中書舍人、戶部侍郎，承旨。

translations.literal: He transferred Outer Court Attendant and Director, was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue, and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred Outer Court Attendant and Director, was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue, and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 出為太原尹、河東節度使。

translations.literal: He was sent out Chief of Taiyuan and Hedong Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out Chief of Taiyuan and Hedong Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 入拜京兆尹，復為戶部侍郎、翰林學士。

translations.literal: He entered court as Chief of the Capital and again became Vice Minister of Revenue and Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Chief of the Capital and again became Vice Minister of Revenue and Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 十年，以本官同平章事，加中書侍郎，兼刑部尚書、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, added Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Justice, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, added Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Justice, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 十一年八月，同昌公主薨，懿宗尤嗟惜之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eleventh year Princess Tongchang died and Emperor Yizong especially lamented her.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eleventh year Princess Tongchang died and Emperor Yizong especially lamented her.

sentences.zh: 以翰林醫官韓宗召、康仲殷等用藥無效，收之下獄。

translations.literal: Because Hanlin medical officers Han Zongzhao, Kang Zhongyin, and others used medicine without effect, they were arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hanlin medical officers Han Zongzhao, Kang Zhongyin, and others used medicine without effect, they were arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 兩家宗族，枝蔓盡捕三百余人，狴牢皆滿。

translations.literal: The two families' clans and branches—all more than three hundred persons—were captured; the prisons were full.
translations.idiomatic: The two families' clans and branches—all more than three hundred persons—were captured; the prisons were full.

sentences.zh: 瞻召諫官令上疏，無敢極言。

translations.literal: Zhan summoned remonstrators and ordered them to submit memorials; none dared speak to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan summoned remonstrators and ordered them to submit memorials; none dared speak to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 瞻自上疏曰：

translations.literal: Zhan himself submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: Zhan himself submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 自陛下雷霆一怒，朝野震驚，囚九族於狴牢，因兩人之藥誤。

translations.literal: Since Your Majesty's thunderous rage, court and countryside were shaken; nine clans were imprisoned and because of two men's mistaken medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty's thunderous rage, court and countryside were shaken; nine clans were imprisoned and because of two men's mistaken medicine.

sentences.zh: 老幼械系三百余人，咸云：「宗召荷恩之日，寸祿不沾，進藥之時，又不同議。

translations.literal: Old and young in shackles, more than three hundred persons, all said, "On the day Zongzhao received grace not a foot of salary was touched; when medicine was administered he likewise did not jointly discuss.
translations.idiomatic: Old and young in shackles, more than three hundred persons, all said, "On the day Zongzhao received grace not a foot of salary was touched; when medicine was administered he likewise did not jointly discuss.

sentences.zh: 此乃禍從天降，罪匪己為。」

translations.literal: This is calamity falling from heaven—the crime is not self-wrought."
translations.idiomatic: This is calamity falling from heaven—the crime is not self-wrought."

sentences.zh: 物議沸騰，道路嗟嘆。

translations.literal: Public opinion boiled and people on the roads sighed.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion boiled and people on the roads sighed.

sentences.zh: 陛下以寬仁厚德，禦宇十年，四海萬邦，鹹歌聖政。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, with generous benevolence and thick virtue, has ruled the realm ten years; within the four seas and ten thousand states all sing of sacred governance.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, with generous benevolence and thick virtue, has ruled the realm ten years; within the four seas and ten thousand states all sing of sacred governance.

sentences.zh: 何事遽移前誌，頓易初心。

translations.literal: Why suddenly shift the former resolve and abruptly change the original heart?
translations.idiomatic: Why suddenly shift the former resolve and abruptly change the original heart?

sentences.zh: 以達理知命之君，涉肆暴不明之謗。

translations.literal: For a ruler who knows fate through reason, to involve reckless cruelty and unclear blame.
translations.idiomatic: For a ruler who knows fate through reason, to involve reckless cruelty and unclear blame.

sentences.zh: 且殉宮女而違道，囚平人而結冤，此皆陛下安不思危，忿不顧難者也。

translations.literal: Moreover to follow a palace woman's death against the Way and imprison common people to knot enmity—these are cases where Your Majesty is secure without thinking of danger and angry without considering difficulty.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover to follow a palace woman's death against the Way and imprison common people to knot enmity—these are cases where Your Majesty is secure without thinking of danger and angry without considering difficulty.

sentences.zh: 陛下信崇釋典，留意生天，大要不過喜舍慈悲，方便布施，不生惡念，所謂福田。

translations.literal: Your Majesty trusts and honors the Buddhist canon and attends to rebirth in heaven; the great essentials are nothing beyond delighting in giving, compassion, convenient generosity, and not giving rise to evil thoughts—the so-called field of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty trusts and honors the Buddhist canon and attends to rebirth in heaven; the great essentials are nothing beyond delighting in giving, compassion, convenient generosity, and not giving rise to evil thoughts—the so-called field of merit.

sentences.zh: 則業累盡消，往生忉利，比居濁惡，未可同年。

translations.literal: Then accumulated karma is entirely extinguished and one is reborn in Trayastrimsha—compared with dwelling in turbid wickedness it cannot be matched in the same year.
translations.idiomatic: Then accumulated karma is entirely extinguished and one is reborn in Trayastrimsha—compared with dwelling in turbid wickedness it cannot be matched in the same year.

sentences.zh: 伏望陛下盡釋系囚，易怒為喜，虔奉空王之教，以資愛主之靈。

translations.literal: We humbly hope Your Majesty will fully release the imprisoned, easily change anger to joy, and reverently follow the Empty King's teaching to support the spirit of loving the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly hope Your Majesty will fully release the imprisoned, easily change anger to joy, and reverently follow the Empty King's teaching to support the spirit of loving the ruler.

sentences.zh: 中外臣僚，同深懇激。

translations.literal: Inside and outside, ministers and officials alike deeply urge this.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside, ministers and officials alike deeply urge this.

sentences.zh: 帝閱疏大怒，即日罷瞻相位，檢校刑部尚書、同平章事、江陵尹，充荊南節度等使。

translations.literal: The emperor read the memorial and was greatly enraged; that same day Zhan was removed from the chief-minister post and appointed Acting Minister of Justice, Associate Chief Minister, Chief of Jiangling, and Jingnan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read the memorial and was greatly enraged; that same day Zhan was removed from the chief-minister post and appointed Acting Minister of Justice, Associate Chief Minister, Chief of Jiangling, and Jingnan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 再貶康州刺史，量移虢州刺史。

translations.literal: He was again demoted Prefect of Kang and transferred in measure to Prefect of Guo.
translations.idiomatic: He was again demoted Prefect of Kang and transferred in measure to Prefect of Guo.

sentences.zh: 入朝為太子賓客分司。

translations.literal: He entered court as Crown Prince Guest serving in the branch office.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Crown Prince Guest serving in the branch office.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士戶部侍郎鄭畋、右諫議大夫高湘、比部郎中知制誥楊知至、禮部郎中魏纻、兵部員外張顏、刑部員外崔彥融、御史中丞孫瑝等，皆坐瞻親善貶逐。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Zheng Tian, Right Remonstrator Gao Xiang, Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer Yang Zhizhi, Director in the Ministry of Rites Wei Xu, Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War Zhang Yan, Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Justice Cui Yanrong, and Censor-in-Chief Sun Huang—all because of close friendship with Zhan—were demoted and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Zheng Tian, Right Remonstrator Gao Xiang, Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer Yang Zhizhi, Director in the Ministry of Rites Wei Xu, Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War Zhang Yan, Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Justice Cui Yanrong, and Censor-in-Chief Sun Huang—all because of close friendship with Zhan—were demoted and sent away.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹溫璋仰藥而卒。

translations.literal: Chief of the Capital Wen Zhang took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Chief of the Capital Wen Zhang took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 劉瑑者，彭城人。

translations.literal: Liu Zhuan was a native of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhuan was a native of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 祖璠，父煟。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Fan and his father Wei.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Fan and his father Wei.

sentences.zh: 瑑，開成初進士擢第。

translations.literal: Zhuan, at the beginning of Kaicheng passed the jinshi selection.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuan, at the beginning of Kaicheng passed the jinshi selection.

sentences.zh: 會昌末，累遷尚書郎、知制誥，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the end of Huichang he was repeatedly promoted Director in the Ministry of Revenue, Drafting Officer for Proclamations, and formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Huichang he was repeatedly promoted Director in the Ministry of Revenue, Drafting Officer for Proclamations, and formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大中初，轉刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 瑑精於法律，選大中以前二百四十四年制敕可行用者二千八百六十五條，分為六百四十六門，議其輕重，別成一家法書，號《大中統類》，奏行用之。

translations.literal: Zhuan was skilled in law; he selected from two hundred forty-four years before Dazhong two thousand eight hundred sixty-five enforceable edicts and orders, divided them into six hundred forty-six categories, weighed their severity, and formed a separate legal work called Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era, which he memorialized for use.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuan was skilled in law; he selected from two hundred forty-four years before Dazhong two thousand eight hundred sixty-five enforceable edicts and orders, divided them into six hundred forty-six categories, weighed their severity, and formed a separate legal work called Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era, which he memorialized for use.

sentences.zh: 出為河南尹，遷檢校工部尚書、汴州刺史、宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was sent out Chief of Henan, transferred Acting Minister of Public Works, Prefect of Bian, and Xuanwu Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out Chief of Henan, transferred Acting Minister of Public Works, Prefect of Bian, and Xuanwu Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，加檢校禮部尚書、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year he was added Acting Minister of Rites, Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner and Observer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year he was added Acting Minister of Rites, Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner and Observer.

sentences.zh: 其年十二月入朝，拜戶部侍郎，判度支。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year he entered court and was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year he entered court and was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 尋以本官同平章事，領使如故。

translations.literal: Soon with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and continued as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and continued as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二年，累加集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was repeatedly added Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was repeatedly added Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 罷相，又歷方鎮，卒。

translations.literal: Removed as chief minister he again passed through regional commands and died.
translations.idiomatic: Removed as chief minister he again passed through regional commands and died.

sentences.zh: 弟頊，亦登進士第。

translations.literal: His younger brother was Xu, who also passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Xu, who also passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 曹確，字剛中，河南人。

translations.literal: Cao Que, styled Gangzhong, was a native of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Que, styled Gangzhong, was a native of Henan.

sentences.zh: 父景伯，貞元十九年進士擢第，又登制科。

translations.literal: His father Jingbo, in the nineteenth year of Zhenyuan passed the jinshi selection and also passed the special examination.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jingbo, in the nineteenth year of Zhenyuan passed the jinshi selection and also passed the special examination.

sentences.zh: 確，開成二年登進士第，歷聘籓府。

translations.literal: Que, in the second year of Kaicheng passed the jinshi examination and repeatedly served in frontier headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Que, in the second year of Kaicheng passed the jinshi examination and repeatedly served in frontier headquarters.

sentences.zh: 入朝為侍御史，以工部員外郎知制誥，轉郎中，入內署為學士，正拜中書舍人，賜金紫，權知河南尹事。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor, as Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Public Works directed proclamations, transferred Director, entered the inner secretariat as academician, was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, granted gold and purple, and acted as Chief of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attending Censor, as Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Public Works directed proclamations, transferred Director, entered the inner secretariat as academician, was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat, granted gold and purple, and acted as Chief of Henan.

sentences.zh: 入為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He entered court as Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 咸通五年，以本官同平章事，加中書侍郎、監修國史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xiantong, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, added Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xiantong, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister, added Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Supervisor of the National History.

sentences.zh: 確精儒術，器識謹重，動循法度。

translations.literal: Que was skilled in Confucian learning, his capacity and judgment careful and weighty, his actions always following law and measure.
translations.idiomatic: Que was skilled in Confucian learning, his capacity and judgment careful and weighty, his actions always following law and measure.

sentences.zh: 懿宗以伶官李可及為威衛將軍，確執奏曰：「臣覽貞觀故事，太宗初定官品令，文武官共六百四十三員，顧謂房玄齡曰：『朕設此官員，以待賢士。

translations.literal: Emperor Yizong made the actor Li Keji Wei Guard General; Que resolutely submitted, saying, "Your subject has reviewed Zhenguan precedents: when Emperor Taizong first fixed the official rank statute, civil and military officials totaled six hundred forty-three posts; he looked at Fang Xuanling and said, 'We establish these official posts to await worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yizong made the actor Li Keji Wei Guard General; Que resolutely submitted, saying, "Your subject has reviewed Zhenguan precedents: when Emperor Taizong first fixed the official rank statute, civil and military officials totaled six hundred forty-three posts; he looked at Fang Xuanling and said, 'We establish these official posts to await worthy men.

sentences.zh: 工商雜色之流，假令術逾儕類，止可厚給財物，必不可超授官秩，與朝賢君子比肩而立，同坐而食。』

translations.literal: For merchants, artisans, and miscellaneous classes—even if skill surpasses their kind—they may richly receive goods and wealth but must not be promoted beyond official rank to stand shoulder to shoulder with court worthies and gentlemen, sitting and eating together.'
translations.idiomatic: For merchants, artisans, and miscellaneous classes—even if skill surpasses their kind—they may richly receive goods and wealth but must not be promoted beyond official rank to stand shoulder to shoulder with court worthies and gentlemen, sitting and eating together.'

sentences.zh: 太和中，文宗欲以樂官尉遲璋為王府率，拾遺竇洵直極諫，乃改授光州長史。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era Emperor Wenzong wished to make the musician Yuchi Zhang Rate of the Princely Household; Reminder Dou Xunzhi remonstrated to the utmost and he was instead appointed Chief Administrator of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era Emperor Wenzong wished to make the musician Yuchi Zhang Rate of the Princely Household; Reminder Dou Xunzhi remonstrated to the utmost and he was instead appointed Chief Administrator of Guang.

sentences.zh: 伏乞以兩朝故事，別授可及之官。」

translations.literal: I humbly beg that by the two courts' precedents Keji be separately granted another office."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg that by the two courts' precedents Keji be separately granted another office."

sentences.zh: 帝不之聽。

translations.literal: The emperor did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not listen.

sentences.zh: 可及善音律，尤能轉喉為新聲，音辭曲折，聽者忘倦。

translations.literal: Keji was skilled in music and especially able to turn the throat into new sounds; the words and tones were twisting and listeners forgot weariness.
translations.idiomatic: Keji was skilled in music and especially able to turn the throat into new sounds; the words and tones were twisting and listeners forgot weariness.

sentences.zh: 京師屠沽效之，呼為「拍彈」。

translations.literal: Butchers and wine sellers in the capital imitated this and called it "patting and plucking."
translations.idiomatic: Butchers and wine sellers in the capital imitated this and called it "patting and plucking."

sentences.zh: 同昌公主除喪後，帝與淑妃思念不已。

translations.literal: After Princess Tongchang's mourning ended the emperor and Consort Shufei missed her endlessly.
translations.idiomatic: After Princess Tongchang's mourning ended the emperor and Consort Shufei missed her endlessly.

sentences.zh: 可及乃為《嘆百年舞曲》。

translations.literal: Keji then composed the dance "Lament for a Hundred Years."
translations.idiomatic: Keji then composed the dance "Lament for a Hundred Years."

sentences.zh: 舞人珠翠盛飾者數百人，畫魚龍地衣，用官騑五千匹。

translations.literal: Several hundred dancers wore pearl and jade adornments; a carpet painted with fish and dragons was made using five thousand palace steeds.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred dancers wore pearl and jade adornments; a carpet painted with fish and dragons was made using five thousand palace steeds.

sentences.zh: 曲終樂闋，珠璣覆地，詞語淒惻，聞者涕流，帝故寵之。

translations.literal: When the song ended and music ceased pearls and gems covered the ground; the words were mournful and listeners wept; the emperor therefore favored him.
translations.idiomatic: When the song ended and music ceased pearls and gems covered the ground; the words were mournful and listeners wept; the emperor therefore favored him.

sentences.zh: 嘗於安國寺作《菩薩蠻舞》，如佛降生，帝益憐之。

translations.literal: He once at Anguo Temple performed the "Bodhisattva Barbarian" dance like the Buddha's birth; the emperor favored him still more.
translations.idiomatic: He once at Anguo Temple performed the "Bodhisattva Barbarian" dance like the Buddha's birth; the emperor favored him still more.

sentences.zh: 可及嘗為子娶婦，帝賜酒二銀樽，啟之非酒，乃金翠也。

translations.literal: Keji once arranged a marriage for his son; the emperor bestowed two silver goblets—when opened they were not wine but gold and kingfisher feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Keji once arranged a marriage for his son; the emperor bestowed two silver goblets—when opened they were not wine but gold and kingfisher feathers.

sentences.zh: 人無敢非之者，唯確與中尉西門季玄屢論之，帝猶顧待不衰。

translations.literal: No one dared criticize except Que and Chief Eunuch Ximen Jixuan, who repeatedly argued; the emperor still favored him without decline.
translations.idiomatic: No one dared criticize except Que and Chief Eunuch Ximen Jixuan, who repeatedly argued; the emperor still favored him without decline.

sentences.zh: 僖宗即位，崔彥昭奏逐之，死於嶺表。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong acceded Cui Yanzhao memorialized to expel him and he died beyond the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xizong acceded Cui Yanzhao memorialized to expel him and he died beyond the ranges.

sentences.zh: 確累加右僕射，判度支事。

translations.literal: Que was repeatedly added Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Director of Revenue Bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Que was repeatedly added Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Director of Revenue Bureau affairs.

sentences.zh: 在相位六年。

translations.literal: In the chief-minister position six years.
translations.idiomatic: In the chief-minister position six years.

sentences.zh: 九年罷相，檢校司徒、平章事、潤州刺史、鎮海軍節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was removed as chief minister, appointed Acting Minister of Education, Associate Chief Minister, Prefect of Run, and Zhenhai Military Commissioner and Observer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was removed as chief minister, appointed Acting Minister of Education, Associate Chief Minister, Prefect of Run, and Zhenhai Military Commissioner and Observer.

sentences.zh: 以出師扞龐勛功，就加太子太師。

translations.literal: For merit in dispatching troops against Pang Xun he was promoted Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in dispatching troops against Pang Xun he was promoted Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 弟汾，亦進士登第，累官尚書郎、知制誥，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: Younger brother Fen also passed the jinshi examination, rose repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, and was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Fen also passed the jinshi examination, rose repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, and was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 出為河南尹，遷檢校工部尚書、許州刺史、忠武軍節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: He was sent out Chief of Henan, transferred Acting Minister of Public Works, Prefect of Xu, and Zhongwu Military Commissioner and Observer.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out Chief of Henan, transferred Acting Minister of Public Works, Prefect of Xu, and Zhongwu Military Commissioner and Observer.

sentences.zh: 入為戶部侍郎，判度支。

translations.literal: He entered court as Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Vice Minister of Revenue and Director of the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 弟兄並列將相之任，人士榮之。

translations.literal: The brothers both held posts of general and chief minister; scholars honored them.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers both held posts of general and chief minister; scholars honored them.

sentences.zh: 確與畢諴俱以儒術進用，及居相位，廉儉貞苦，君子多之，稱為曹、畢。

translations.literal: Que and Bi Xian both advanced through Confucian learning; in the chief-minister position they were frugal, upright, and bitterly austere—gentlemen greatly esteemed them and called them Cao and Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Que and Bi Xian both advanced through Confucian learning; in the chief-minister position they were frugal, upright, and bitterly austere—gentlemen greatly esteemed them and called them Cao and Bi.

sentences.zh: 畢諴者，字存之，鄆州須昌人也。

translations.literal: Bi Xian, styled Cunzhi, was a native of Xuchang in Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Xian, styled Cunzhi, was a native of Xuchang in Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 伯祖構，高宗時吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Great-uncle Gou served as Minister of Personnel in Emperor Gaozong's time.
translations.idiomatic: Great-uncle Gou served as Minister of Personnel in Emperor Gaozong's time.

sentences.zh: 構弟栩，酆王府司馬，生淩。

translations.literal: Gou's younger brother Xu was Prince of Feng's household marshal and begot Ling.
translations.idiomatic: Gou's younger brother Xu was Prince of Feng's household marshal and begot Ling.

sentences.zh: 淩為汾州長史，生勻，為協律郎。

translations.literal: Ling served as Chief Administrator of Fen and begot Yun, who was Harmonizing Law Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Ling served as Chief Administrator of Fen and begot Yun, who was Harmonizing Law Officer.

sentences.zh: 勻生諴，少孤貧，燃薪讀書，刻苦自勵。

translations.literal: Yun begot Xian, who from youth was orphaned and poor, burned firewood to read books, and strove bitterly to encourage himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yun begot Xian, who from youth was orphaned and poor, burned firewood to read books, and strove bitterly to encourage himself.

sentences.zh: 既長，博通經史，尤能歌詩。

translations.literal: When grown he was broadly versed in the classics and histories and especially skilled at song and poetry.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he was broadly versed in the classics and histories and especially skilled at song and poetry.

sentences.zh: 端愨好古，交遊不雜。
