translations.literal: Upright and fond of antiquity, his associations were not mixed.
translations.idiomatic: Upright and fond of antiquity, his associations were not mixed.

sentences.zh: 太和中，進士擢第，又以書判拔萃，尚書杜悰鎮許昌，辟為從事。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he passed the jinshi selection and also distinguished himself in document judgment; Minister Du Cong governed Xuchang and summoned him as staff member.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he passed the jinshi selection and also distinguished himself in document judgment; Minister Du Cong governed Xuchang and summoned him as staff member.

sentences.zh: 悰領度支，諴為巡官。

translations.literal: When Cong directed the Revenue Bureau Xian served as patrol officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong directed the Revenue Bureau Xian served as patrol officer.

sentences.zh: 悰鎮揚州，又從之。

translations.literal: When Cong governed Yang Prefecture Xian followed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong governed Yang Prefecture Xian followed him.

sentences.zh: 悰入相，諴為監察，轉侍御史。

translations.literal: When Cong entered the chief-minister post Xian served as Attending Censor and transferred Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong entered the chief-minister post Xian served as Attending Censor and transferred Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 武宗朝，宰相李德裕專政，出悰為東蜀節度。

translations.literal: In Emperor Wuzong's court Chief Minister Li Deyu monopolized governance and sent Cong out as Eastern Shu Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Wuzong's court Chief Minister Li Deyu monopolized governance and sent Cong out as Eastern Shu Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 悰之故吏，莫敢餞送問訊，唯諴無所顧慮，問遺不絕。

translations.literal: Cong's former clerks dared not see him off or inquire after him; only Xian had no such concern and his visits and gifts never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Cong's former clerks dared not see him off or inquire after him; only Xian had no such concern and his visits and gifts never ceased.

sentences.zh: 德裕怒，出諴為磁州刺史。

translations.literal: Deyu was angry and sent Xian out as Prefect of Ci.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu was angry and sent Xian out as Prefect of Ci.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，德裕得罪，凡被譴者皆征還。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded Deyu was condemned; all who had been punished were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded Deyu was condemned; all who had been punished were recalled.

sentences.zh: 諴入為戶部員外郎，分司東都，歷駕部員外郎、倉部郎中。

translations.literal: Xian entered court as Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Revenue, serving in the Eastern Capital branch, and passed through Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Tributary Carriages and Director in the Ministry of Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Xian entered court as Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Revenue, serving in the Eastern Capital branch, and passed through Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Tributary Carriages and Director in the Ministry of Granaries.

sentences.zh: 故事，勢門子弟，鄙倉、駕二曹，居之者不悅。

translations.literal: By precedent sons of powerful gates despised the Granaries and Tributary Carriages bureaus; those who held them were displeased.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent sons of powerful gates despised the Granaries and Tributary Carriages bureaus; those who held them were displeased.

sentences.zh: 唯諴受命，恬然恭遜，口無異言，執政多之。

translations.literal: Only Xian accepted appointment, calm and respectful, with no unusual words; those in power greatly approved.
translations.idiomatic: Only Xian accepted appointment, calm and respectful, with no unusual words; those in power greatly approved.

sentences.zh: 改職方郎中，兼侍御史知雜。

translations.literal: He was reassigned Director in the Ministry of War and concurrent Attending Censor with mixed duties.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned Director in the Ministry of War and concurrent Attending Censor with mixed duties.

sentences.zh: 其年。

translations.literal: That year.
translations.idiomatic: That year.

sentences.zh: 召為翰林學士、中書舍人，遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was summoned Hanlin Academician and Gentleman of the Secretariat and transferred Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned Hanlin Academician and Gentleman of the Secretariat and transferred Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 自大中末，党項羌叛，屢擾河西。

translations.literal: From the end of Dazhong the Tangut tribes rebelled and repeatedly disturbed Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: From the end of Dazhong the Tangut tribes rebelled and repeatedly disturbed Hexi.

sentences.zh: 宣宗召學士對邊事。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong summoned academicians to discuss frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong summoned academicians to discuss frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 諴即援引古今，論列破羌之狀。

translations.literal: Xian at once cited ancient and modern examples and laid out the form of breaking the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xian at once cited ancient and modern examples and laid out the form of breaking the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 上悅，曰：「吾方擇能帥，安集河西，不期頗、牧在吾禁署，卿為朕行乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and said, "We are just choosing an able commander to settle and gather Hexi—unexpectedly Po and Mu are in Our forbidden secretariat; will you, minister, go for Us?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and said, "We are just choosing an able commander to settle and gather Hexi—unexpectedly Po and Mu are in Our forbidden secretariat; will you, minister, go for Us?"

sentences.zh: 諴忻然從命，即用諴為邠寧節度、河西供軍安撫等使。

translations.literal: Xian gladly accepted the command and was at once appointed Binning Military Commissioner and Hexi Supply Army Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xian gladly accepted the command and was at once appointed Binning Military Commissioner and Hexi Supply Army Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 諴至軍，遣使告喻叛徒，諸羌率化。

translations.literal: When Xian reached the army he sent envoys to announce and admonish the rebels; the various Qiang submitted to transformation.
translations.idiomatic: When Xian reached the army he sent envoys to announce and admonish the rebels; the various Qiang submitted to transformation.

sentences.zh: 又以邊境禦戎，以兵多積谷為上策。

translations.literal: Also, for frontier defense against barbarians, accumulating much grain with many troops was the upper strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Also, for frontier defense against barbarians, accumulating much grain with many troops was the upper strategy.

sentences.zh: 乃召募軍士，開置屯田，歲收谷三十萬石，省度支錢數百萬。

translations.literal: Then he recruited soldiers and opened garrison farms; yearly harvest was three hundred thousand shi of grain, saving several million strings from the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Then he recruited soldiers and opened garrison farms; yearly harvest was three hundred thousand shi of grain, saving several million strings from the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 詔書嘉之，就加檢校工部尚書，移鎮澤潞，充昭義節度使。

translations.literal: An edict praised this and he was promoted Acting Minister of Public Works and transferred to govern Ze-Lu as Zhaoyi Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised this and he was promoted Acting Minister of Public Works and transferred to govern Ze-Lu as Zhaoyi Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二年，改太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the second year he was reassigned Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was reassigned Chief of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Hedong Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太原近胡，九姓為亂。

translations.literal: Taiyuan is near the Hu; the nine surnames made disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan is near the Hu; the nine surnames made disorder.

sentences.zh: 諴明賞罰，謹斥候，期年，諸部革心。

translations.literal: Xian made rewards and punishments clear and kept scouts strict; within a year the various tribes changed heart.
translations.idiomatic: Xian made rewards and punishments clear and kept scouts strict; within a year the various tribes changed heart.

sentences.zh: 就加檢校尚書左僕射，移授汴州刺史，充宣武軍節度、宋亳汴觀察等使。

translations.literal: He was promoted Acting Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and transferred Prefect of Bian, serving as Xuanwu Military Commissioner and Song-Bo-Bian Observer.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted Acting Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and transferred Prefect of Bian, serving as Xuanwu Military Commissioner and Song-Bo-Bian Observer.

sentences.zh: 其年，入為戶部尚書，領度支。

translations.literal: That year he entered court as Minister of Revenue and directed the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: That year he entered court as Minister of Revenue and directed the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 月余，改禮部尚書，同平章事，累遷中書侍郎、兵部尚書、集賢大學士。

translations.literal: After more than a month he was reassigned Minister of Rites and Associate Chief Minister, repeatedly promoted Vice Director of the Secretariat, Minister of War, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month he was reassigned Minister of Rites and Associate Chief Minister, repeatedly promoted Vice Director of the Secretariat, Minister of War, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 在相位三年，十月以疾固辭位，詔守兵部尚書，以其本官同平章事，出鎮河中。

translations.literal: In the chief-minister position three years; in the tenth month he firmly declined the post because of illness; an edict ordered him to serve as Minister of War with his existing office as Associate Chief Minister and sent him out to govern Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the chief-minister position three years; in the tenth month he firmly declined the post because of illness; an edict ordered him to serve as Minister of War with his existing office as Associate Chief Minister and sent him out to govern Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 十二月二十三日，卒於鎮，時年六十二。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day of the twelfth month he died in his command at age sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third day of the twelfth month he died in his command at age sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 諴謹重，長於文學，尤精吏術。

translations.literal: Xian was careful and weighty, skilled in literature, and especially expert in administrative technique.
translations.idiomatic: Xian was careful and weighty, skilled in literature, and especially expert in administrative technique.

sentences.zh: 在相位，以同官任情不法，固辭而免，君子美之。

translations.literal: In the chief-minister position, because fellow ministers acted at will against law, he firmly declined and was removed—gentlemen praised this.
translations.idiomatic: In the chief-minister position, because fellow ministers acted at will against law, he firmly declined and was removed—gentlemen praised this.

sentences.zh: 子紹顏、知顏，登進士第，累歷顯官。

translations.literal: His sons Shaoyan and Zhiyan passed the jinshi examination and repeatedly held prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Shaoyan and Zhiyan passed the jinshi examination and repeatedly held prominent posts.

sentences.zh: 杜審權，字殷衡，京兆人也。

translations.literal: Du Shenquan, styled Yinheng, was a native of the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shenquan, styled Yinheng, was a native of the capital district.

sentences.zh: 國初萊成公如晦六代孫。

translations.literal: He was sixth-generation descendant of Duke Lai Cheng Ruhui of the founding era.
translations.idiomatic: He was sixth-generation descendant of Duke Lai Cheng Ruhui of the founding era.

sentences.zh: 祖佐，位終大理正。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zuo ended as Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zuo ended as Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 佐生二子：元潁、元絳。

translations.literal: Zuo had two sons: Yuanying and Yuanjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo had two sons: Yuanying and Yuanjiang.

sentences.zh: 元潁，穆宗朝宰相。

translations.literal: Yuanying was chief minister in Emperor Muzong's court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanying was chief minister in Emperor Muzong's court.

sentences.zh: 絳位終太子賓客。

translations.literal: Jiang ended as Crown Prince Guest.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang ended as Crown Prince Guest.

sentences.zh: 絳生二子：審權、蔚，並登進士第。

translations.literal: Jiang had two sons: Shenquan and Wei, both of whom passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang had two sons: Shenquan and Wei, both of whom passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 審權，釋褐江西觀察判官，又以書判拔萃，拜右拾遺，轉左補闕。

translations.literal: Shenquan, upon leaving office, served as judge of the Jiangxi Observation Commission; with distinguished performance in document judgment he was appointed Right Reminder and transferred Left Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: Shenquan, upon leaving office, served as judge of the Jiangxi Observation Commission; with distinguished performance in document judgment he was appointed Right Reminder and transferred Left Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 大中初，遷司勛員外郎，轉郎中知雜。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War and Director with mixed duties.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War and Director with mixed duties.

sentences.zh: 又以本官知制誥，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: Again with his existing office he directed proclamations and was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Again with his existing office he directed proclamations and was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十年，權知禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as Director of the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he acted as Director of the Ministry of Rites examination.

sentences.zh: 十一年，選士三十人，後多至達官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he selected thirty candidates; many later reached high office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he selected thirty candidates; many later reached high office.

sentences.zh: 正拜禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was formally appointed Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，出為陜州大都督府長史、陜虢都團練觀察使，加檢校戶部尚書、河中尹、河中晉絳節度使。

translations.literal: That winter he was sent out Chief Administrator of Shaan Superior Protectorate, Shaan-Guo Training-and-Observation Commissioner, Acting Minister of Revenue, Chief of Hezhong, and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was sent out Chief Administrator of Shaan Superior Protectorate, Shaan-Guo Training-and-Observation Commissioner, Acting Minister of Revenue, Chief of Hezhong, and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 懿宗即位，召拜吏部尚書。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yizong acceded he was summoned and appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yizong acceded he was summoned and appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三年，以本官同平章事，累加門下侍郎、右僕射。

translations.literal: In the third year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and was repeatedly added Vice Director of the Secretariat and Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, with his existing office he became Associate Chief Minister and was repeatedly added Vice Director of the Secretariat and Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 九年罷相，檢校司空，兼潤州刺史、鎮海軍節度使、蘇杭常等州觀察使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was removed as chief minister, appointed Acting Minister of Works, concurrent Prefect of Run, Zhenhai Military Commissioner, and Observer of Su, Hang, and Chang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was removed as chief minister, appointed Acting Minister of Works, concurrent Prefect of Run, Zhenhai Military Commissioner, and Observer of Su, Hang, and Chang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 時徐州戍將龐勛自桂州擅還，據徐、泗，大擾淮南。

translations.literal: At the time Xu garrison general Pang Xun on his own returned from Guiz Prefecture, held Xu and Si, and greatly disturbed Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xu garrison general Pang Xun on his own returned from Guiz Prefecture, held Xu and Si, and greatly disturbed Huainan.

sentences.zh: 審權與淮南節度使令狐綯、荊南節度使崔鉉，奉詔出師，掎角討賊；

translations.literal: Shenquan with Huainan Military Commissioner Linghu Tao and Jingnan Military Commissioner Cui Xuan, by edict dispatched troops, pincered and attacked the bandits;
translations.idiomatic: Shenquan with Huainan Military Commissioner Linghu Tao and Jingnan Military Commissioner Cui Xuan, by edict dispatched troops, pincered and attacked the bandits;

sentences.zh: 而浙西饋運不絕，繼破徐戎。

translations.literal: yet Zhexi supply transport never ceased and they successively broke the Xu rebels.
translations.idiomatic: yet Zhexi supply transport never ceased and they successively broke the Xu rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊平，召拜尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified he was summoned and appointed Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits were pacified he was summoned and appointed Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一年，制曰：

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict read:
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year an edict read:

sentences.zh: 數年以本官兼許州刺史、忠武軍節度觀察等使，入為太子太傅，分司東都。

translations.literal: For several years with his existing office he was concurrent Prefect of Xu and Zhongwu Military Commissioner and Observer; he entered court as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, serving in the Eastern Capital branch, and died.
translations.idiomatic: For several years with his existing office he was concurrent Prefect of Xu and Zhongwu Military Commissioner and Observer; he entered court as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, serving in the Eastern Capital branch, and died.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太師，謚曰德。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title De.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title De.

sentences.zh: 三子：讓能、彥林、弘徽。

translations.literal: Three sons: Rangneng, Yanlin, and Honghui.
translations.idiomatic: Three sons: Rangneng, Yanlin, and Honghui.

sentences.zh: 讓能，咸通十四年登進士第，釋褐咸陽尉。

translations.literal: Rangneng, in the fourteenth year of Xiantong passed the jinshi examination and left office as Assistant Magistrate of Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng, in the fourteenth year of Xiantong passed the jinshi examination and left office as Assistant Magistrate of Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 宰相王鐸鎮汴，奏為推官。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Wang Duo governed Bian and memorialized him as investigating officer.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Wang Duo governed Bian and memorialized him as investigating officer.

sentences.zh: 入為長安尉、集賢校理。

translations.literal: He entered court as Assistant Magistrate of Chang'an and Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Assistant Magistrate of Chang'an and Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，以孝聞。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his mother and was known for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: He entered mourning for his mother and was known for filial piety.

sentences.zh: 服闋，淮南節度使劉鄴辟掌記室，得殿中，賜緋。

translations.literal: When mourning ended Huainan Military Commissioner Liu Ye summoned him to manage the secretariat; he obtained Palace Attendance and was granted crimson.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended Huainan Military Commissioner Liu Ye summoned him to manage the secretariat; he obtained Palace Attendance and was granted crimson.

sentences.zh: 入為監察。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 牛蔚鎮興元，奏為節度判官。

translations.literal: Niu Wei governed Xingyuan and memorialized him as military commission judge.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Wei governed Xingyuan and memorialized him as military commission judge.

sentences.zh: 入為右補闕，歷侍御史、起居郎、禮部、兵部員外郎。

translations.literal: He entered court as Right Remonstrator and passed through Attending Censor, Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Outer Court Attendant in the Ministries of Rites and War.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Right Remonstrator and passed through Attending Censor, Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Outer Court Attendant in the Ministries of Rites and War.

sentences.zh: 蕭遘領度支，以本官判度支案。

translations.literal: Xiao Zui directed the Revenue Bureau and with his existing office judged Revenue Bureau cases.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zui directed the Revenue Bureau and with his existing office judged Revenue Bureau cases.

sentences.zh: 黃巢犯京師，奔赴行在，拜禮部郎中、史館修撰。

translations.literal: When Huang Chao attacked the capital he rushed to the traveling palace and was appointed Director in the Ministry of Rites and Historiographer.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao attacked the capital he rushed to the traveling palace and was appointed Director in the Ministry of Rites and Historiographer.

sentences.zh: 尋以本官知制誥，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: Soon with his existing office he directed proclamations and was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with his existing office he directed proclamations and was formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 謝日，面賜金紫之服，尋召充翰林學士。

translations.literal: On the day of thanks he was personally granted gold and purple robes; soon he was summoned Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of thanks he was personally granted gold and purple robes; soon he was summoned Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 六飛在蜀，關東用兵，征發招懷，書詔雲委。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage was in Shu, east of the Pass troops were raised; recruitment, conscription, and soothing filled edicts and proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage was in Shu, east of the Pass troops were raised; recruitment, conscription, and soothing filled edicts and proclamations.

sentences.zh: 讓能詞才敏速，筆無點竄，動中事機，僖宗嘉之，累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Rangneng's literary talent was quick; his brush needed no correction and he always hit the moment's need; Emperor Xizong praised this and repeatedly promoted him Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng's literary talent was quick; his brush needed no correction and he always hit the moment's need; Emperor Xizong praised this and repeatedly promoted him Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 從駕還京，加禮部尚書，進階銀青光祿大夫，封建平縣開國子，食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: When the carriage returned to the capital he was added Minister of Rites, promoted Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, enfeoffed Baron of Jianping with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage returned to the capital he was added Minister of Rites, promoted Silver Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, enfeoffed Baron of Jianping with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 轉兵部尚書、學士承旨。

translations.literal: He transferred Minister of War and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred Minister of War and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 沙阤逼京師，僖宗蒼黃出幸。

translations.literal: When Shatuo pressed the capital Emperor Xizong fled in haste.
translations.idiomatic: When Shatuo pressed the capital Emperor Xizong fled in haste.

sentences.zh: 是夜，讓能宿直禁中，聞難作，步出從駕。

translations.literal: That night Rangneng was on night duty in the forbidden palace; hearing trouble arise he walked out to follow the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: That night Rangneng was on night duty in the forbidden palace; hearing trouble arise he walked out to follow the carriage.

sentences.zh: 出城十餘里，得遺馬一匹，無羈勒，以紳束首而乘之。

translations.literal: More than ten li outside the city he obtained a stray horse; without bridle or reins he bound its head with his sash and rode it.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten li outside the city he obtained a stray horse; without bridle or reins he bound its head with his sash and rode it.

sentences.zh: 駕在鳳翔，朱玫兵遽至；

translations.literal: When the carriage was at Fengxiang Zhu Mei's troops suddenly arrived;
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage was at Fengxiang Zhu Mei's troops suddenly arrived;

sentences.zh: 僖宗急幸寶雞，近臣唯讓能獨從。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong hastily went to Baoji; among close ministers only Rangneng followed alone.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong hastely went to Baoji; among close ministers only Rangneng followed alone.

sentences.zh: 翌日。

translations.literal: The next day.
translations.idiomatic: The next day.

sentences.zh: 孔緯等六七人至。

translations.literal: Kong Wei and six or seven others arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Wei and six or seven others arrived.

sentences.zh: 邠師攻關，帝幸梁、漢，棧道為石協所毀，崎嶇險阻之間，不離左右。

translations.literal: When Bin troops attacked the Pass the emperor went to Liang and Han; the plank road was destroyed by Shi Xie; amid rugged peril he never left the emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: When Bin troops attacked the Pass the emperor went to Liang and Han; the plank road was destroyed by Shi Xie; amid rugged peril he never left the emperor's side.

sentences.zh: 帝顧謂之曰：「朕之失道，再致播遷。

translations.literal: The emperor turned to him and said, "Our losing the Way twice caused exile.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor turned to him and said, "Our losing the Way twice caused exile.

sentences.zh: 險難之中，卿常在側，古所謂忠於所事，卿無負矣！」

translations.literal: Amid danger and hardship you were always at Our side—what antiquity calls loyalty to one's charge; you have not failed Us!"
translations.idiomatic: Amid danger and hardship you were always at Our side—what antiquity calls loyalty to one's charge; you have not failed Us!"

sentences.zh: 讓能謝曰：「臣家世歷重任，蒙國厚恩，陛下不以臣愚，擢居近侍。

translations.literal: Rangneng declined, saying, "Your subject's family for generations held heavy responsibility and received the state's thick grace; Your Majesty did not think your subject foolish and promoted him to close attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng declined, saying, "Your subject's family for generations held heavy responsibility and received the state's thick grace; Your Majesty did not think your subject foolish and promoted him to close attendance.

sentences.zh: 臨難茍免，臣之恥也；

translations.literal: To escape in crisis would be your subject's shame;
translations.idiomatic: To escape in crisis would be your subject's shame;

sentences.zh: 獲扞牧圉，臣之幸也。」

translations.literal: to be able to guard the ruler's carriage is your subject's fortune."
translations.idiomatic: to be able to guard the ruler's carriage is your subject's fortune."

sentences.zh: 至褒中，加金紫光祿大夫，改兵部侍郎，同平章事。

translations.literal: When they reached Bao he was added Golden Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, reassigned Vice Minister of War, and Associate Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Bao he was added Golden Light Grand Master of Palace Attendance, reassigned Vice Minister of War, and Associate Chief Minister.

sentences.zh: 時朱玫立襄王稱制，天下牧伯附之者十六七，貢賦殆絕。

translations.literal: At the time Zhu Mei established the Prince of Xiang as regent; regional shepherds who joined numbered sixteen or seventeen and tribute nearly ceased.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhu Mei established the Prince of Xiang as regent; regional shepherds who joined numbered sixteen or seventeen and tribute nearly ceased.

sentences.zh: 朝士才十數人，行帑無寸金，衛兵不宿飽。

translations.literal: Court scholars numbered only a dozen or so; traveling treasury had not a foot of gold and guard soldiers did not sleep full.
translations.idiomatic: Court scholars numbered only a dozen or so; traveling treasury had not a foot of gold and guard soldiers did not sleep full.

sentences.zh: 帝垂泣側席，無如之何。

translations.literal: The emperor wept on the side of the mat and had no remedy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept on the side of the mat and had no remedy.

sentences.zh: 讓能首陳大計，請以重臣使河中，諭王重榮以大義，果承詔請雪，以圖討逆。

translations.literal: Rangneng first stated the great plan, requesting that a heavy minister be sent to Hezhong to explain the great principle to Wang Chongrong, who indeed accepted the edict and requested to clear the wrong and plan to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng first stated the great plan, requesting that a heavy minister be sent to Hezhong to explain the great principle to Wang Chongrong, who indeed accepted the edict and requested to clear the wrong and plan to attack the rebels.

sentences.zh: 京師平，拜特進、中書侍郎，兼兵部尚書、集賢殿大學士，進封襄陽郡開國公，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: When the capital was pacified he was appointed Special Advancement, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of War, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, enfeoffed Duke of Xiangyang with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital was pacified he was appointed Special Advancement, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of War, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, enfeoffed Duke of Xiangyang with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 駕在鳳翔，李昌符作亂，倏然變起，讓能單步入侍。

translations.literal: When the carriage was at Fengxiang Li Changfu made disorder; suddenly mutiny arose and Rangneng entered alone to attend.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage was at Fengxiang Li Changfu made disorder; suddenly mutiny arose and Rangneng entered alone to attend.

sentences.zh: 時朝臣受偽署者眾，法司請行極法，以戒事君。

translations.literal: At the time many court scholars accepted false appointments; the law office requested extreme punishment to warn those who serve rulers.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many court scholars accepted false appointments; the law office requested extreme punishment to warn those who serve rulers.

sentences.zh: 讓能固爭之，獲全者十七八。

translations.literal: Rangneng firmly argued and seventeen or eighteen were preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng firmly argued and seventeen or eighteen were preserved.

sentences.zh: 昭宗纂嗣，賜「扶危啟運保乂功臣」，加開府儀同三司、尚書左僕射，封晉國公，增邑千戶，仍賜鐵券。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhaozong succeeded he was granted "Meritorious Minister Who Supports Crisis, Initiates Fortune, and Preserves the Realm," added Grand Preceptor of the Palace, Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, enfeoffed Duke of Jin with an added fief of one thousand households, and still granted an iron certificate.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhaozong succeeded he was granted "Meritorious Minister Who Supports Crisis, Initiates Fortune, and Preserves the Realm," added Grand Preceptor of the Palace, Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, enfeoffed Duke of Jin with an added fief of one thousand households, and still granted an iron certificate.

sentences.zh: 誅秦宗權，許、蔡平定，加司空、門下侍郎、監修國史。

translations.literal: When Qin Zongquan was executed Xu and Cai were pacified; he was added Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Zongquan was executed Xu and Cai were pacified; he was added Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Supervisor of the National History.

sentences.zh: 昭宗郊禮畢，進位司徒、太清宮使、弘文館大學士、延資庫使、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使，加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhaozong completed the suburban sacrifice he was promoted Minister of Education, Commissioner of the Great Pure Palace, Grand Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture, Commissioner of the Extension Capital Store, and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits, with fief increased one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhaozong completed the suburban sacrifice he was promoted Minister of Education, Commissioner of the Great Pure Palace, Grand Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture, Commissioner of the Extension Capital Store, and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits, with fief increased one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 明年，冊拜太尉，加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: The next year he was enfeoffed Grand Preceptor with fief increased one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was enfeoffed Grand Preceptor with fief increased one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 自大順已來，鳳翔李茂貞大聚兵甲，恃功驕恣。

translations.literal: From Datong onward Li Maozhen of Fengxiang greatly gathered armor and weapons and relied on merit to be proud and unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: From Datong onward Li Maozhen of Fengxiang greatly gathered armor and weapons and relied on merit to be proud and unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 會楊復恭走山南，茂貞欲兼有梁、漢之地，亟請問罪，詔未允而出師。

translations.literal: When Yang Fugong fled to Shannan Maozhen wished to annex Liang and Han lands and urgently requested permission to punish guilt; the edict did not yet consent when he dispatched troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Fugong fled to Shannan Maozhen wished to annex Liang and Han lands and urgently requested permission to punish guilt; the edict did not yet consent when he dispatched troops.

sentences.zh: 昭宗怒其專，不得已而從之。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaozong was angry at his presumption and had no choice but to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaozong was angry at his presumption and had no choice but to follow.

sentences.zh: 及山南平，詔授以茂貞鎮興元，徐彥若鎮鳳翔，仍割果、閬兩州隸武定軍。

translations.literal: When Shannan was pacified an edict granted Maozhen governorship of Xingyuan, Xu Yanruo governorship of Fengxiang, and still ceded Guo and Lang prefectures to the Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Shannan was pacified an edict granted Maozhen governorship of Xingyuan, Xu Yanruo governorship of Fengxiang, and still ceded Guo and Lang prefectures to the Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 茂貞怒，上章論列，語辭不遜。

translations.literal: Maozhen was angry and submitted a memorial arguing; his words were not deferential.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen was angry and submitted a memorial arguing; his words were not deferential.

sentences.zh: 又與讓能書曰：

translations.literal: He also wrote to Rangneng saying:
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote to Rangneng saying:

sentences.zh: 「今明公舍築入夢，投竿為師，踐履中臺，制臨外閫，不究興亡之理，罕聞沈斷之機。

translations.literal: "Now the eminent lord abandons building in dreams and casts the fishing rod to become commander, treads the middle terrace and controls the outer command—he does not examine the logic of rise and fall and rarely hears of resolute judgment.
translations.idiomatic: "Now the eminent lord abandons building in dreams and casts the fishing rod to become commander, treads the middle terrace and controls the outer command—he does not examine the logic of rise and fall and rarely hears of resolute judgment.

sentences.zh: 蓋意有所不平，心有所未悟，輒思上問，願審臧謀。

translations.literal: Surely intent is somewhat unequal and heart somewhat unenlightened; then one thinks to question above and wishes careful examination of hidden counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Surely intent is somewhat unequal and heart somewhat unenlightened; then one thinks to question above and wishes careful examination of hidden counsel.

sentences.zh: 竊見楊守亮擅舉干戈，阻艱西道，將圖割據，吞並東川。

translations.literal: I see Yang Shouliang on his own raising weapons, blocking the hard western route, intending to carve out territory and swallow Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: I see Yang Shouliang on his own raising weapons, blocking the hard western route, intending to carve out territory and swallow Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 居巴、幹為一窟豺狼，在梁、漢致十年荊棘。

translations.literal: Dwelling in Ba and Qian as one den of wolves and jackals, in Liang and Han causing ten years of brambles.
translations.idiomatic: Dwelling in Ba and Qian as one den of wolves and jackals, in Liang and Han causing ten years of brambles.

sentences.zh: 果聞敗衄，尋挫兇狂。

translations.literal: Indeed I heard of defeat and rout and soon checked fierce madness.
translations.idiomatic: Indeed I heard of defeat and rout and soon checked fierce madness.

sentences.zh: 既前去而不諧，思卻歸而無地。

translations.literal: Having gone forward without harmony, he thought to return but had no place.
translations.idiomatic: Having gone forward without harmony, he thought to return but had no place.

sentences.zh: 當道與邠州見為隔絕綱運，方舉問罪兵師，忽聞朝廷授武定之雙旌，割果、閬之兩郡，未審是何名目？

translations.literal: Our route and Bin Prefecture are now cut off from grain transport; just as punitive troops were raised I suddenly heard the court grant Wuding's double banners and cede Guo and Lang two prefectures—may I ask what title this is?
translations.idiomatic: Our route and Bin Prefecture are now cut off from grain transport; just as punitive troops were raised I suddenly heard the court grant Wuding's double banners and cede Guo and Lang two prefectures—may I ask what title this is?

sentences.zh: 酬何功勞？

translations.literal: Rewarding what merit?
translations.idiomatic: Rewarding what merit?

sentences.zh: 紊大國之紀綱，蠹天子之州縣，非惟取笑於童稚，抑亦包羞於馬牛。

translations.literal: Disordering the great state's discipline and ruining the Son of Heaven's prefectures and counties—not only ridiculed by children but also shameful to oxen and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Disordering the great state's discipline and ruining the Son of Heaven's prefectures and counties—not only ridiculed by children but also shameful to oxen and horses.

sentences.zh: 自謂奇謀，信為獨見。

translations.literal: Calling it clever strategy—truly a view held alone.
translations.idiomatic: Calling it clever strategy—truly a view held alone.

sentences.zh: 伏慮是明公賞兇黨無君之輩，挫忠臣奉國之心。

translations.literal: I fear the eminent lord rewards the unprincipled faction and frustrates the loyal ministers' spirit of serving the state.
translations.idiomatic: I fear the eminent lord rewards the unprincipled faction and frustrates the loyal ministers' spirit of serving the state.

sentences.zh: 要助奸邪，須摧正直。

translations.literal: To aid the wicked one must crush the upright.
translations.idiomatic: To aid the wicked one must crush the upright.

sentences.zh: 又聞公切於保位，利在安家。

translations.literal: I also hear the lord is eager to preserve position and profit lies in settling the family.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear the lord is eager to preserve position and profit lies in settling the family.

sentences.zh: 商量不自於中書剸割全通於內地。

translations.literal: Consultation not from within the Secretariat cut off and wholly granted to the inner lands.
translations.idiomatic: Consultation not from within the Secretariat cut off and wholly granted to the inner lands.

sentences.zh: 雖知深奧，罕測津涯，亦聞駭異群情，頗，是喧騰眾口。」

translations.literal: Though one knows depth and obscurity and rarely fathoms the ford's edge, I also hear alarm at the crowd's feelings and much clamor in the multitude's mouths."
translations.idiomatic: Though one knows depth and obscurity and rarely fathoms the ford's edge, I also hear alarm at the crowd's feelings and much clamor in the multitude's mouths."

sentences.zh: 其悖戾如此。

translations.literal: His perversity was thus.
translations.idiomatic: His perversity was thus.

sentences.zh: 京師百姓，聞茂貞聚兵甲，群情恟々，數千百人守闕門。

translations.literal: Capital commoners, hearing Maozhen gathered armor and weapons, were alarmed; several thousand hundreds guarded the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Capital commoners, hearing Maozhen gathered armor and weapons, were alarmed; several thousand hundreds guarded the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 候中尉西門重遂出，擁馬論列曰：「乞不分割山南，請姑息鳳翔，與百姓為主。」

translations.literal: Waiting for Chief Eunuch Ximen Zhongsui to come out, they surrounded his horse and argued, saying, "We beg not to divide Shannan; please soothe Fengxiang and be master for the common people."
translations.idiomatic: Waiting for Chief Eunuch Ximen Zhongsui to come out, they surrounded his horse and argued, saying, "We beg not to divide Shannan; please soothe Fengxiang and be master for the common people."

sentences.zh: 重遂曰：「此非吾事，出於宰相也。」

translations.literal: Zhongsui said, "This is not my affair—it comes from the chief minister."
translations.idiomatic: Zhongsui said, "This is not my affair—it comes from the chief minister."

sentences.zh: 昭宗怒，詔讓能只在中書調發畫計，不歸第。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaozong was angry and edicted that Rangneng remain only in the Secretariat to dispatch and plan and not return to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaozong was angry and edicted that Rangneng remain only in the Secretariat to dispatch and plan and not return to his residence.

sentences.zh: 月余，宰相崔昭緯陰結邠、岐為城社，凡讓能出一言，即日達於茂貞、行瑜。

translations.literal: After more than a month Chief Minister Cui Zhaowei secretly allied with Bin and Qi as a city altar; whenever Rangneng spoke one word it reached Maozhen and Xingyu the same day.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month Chief Minister Cui Zhaowei secretly allied with Bin and Qi as a city altar; whenever Rangneng spoke one word it reached Maozhen and Xingyu the same day.

sentences.zh: 茂貞令健兒數百人，雜市人於街。

translations.literal: Maozhen ordered several hundred strong men mixed with market people in the streets.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen ordered several hundred strong men mixed with market people in the streets.

sentences.zh: 崔昭緯、鄭延昌歸第，市人擁肩輿訴曰：「岐帥無罪，幸相公不加討伐，致都邑不寧。」

translations.literal: When Cui Zhaowei and Zheng Yanchang returned home market people surrounded the shoulder carriage and pleaded, saying, "The Qi commander is innocent; we beg the chief ministers not to add punishment and cause the capital to be unsettled."
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Zhaowei and Zheng Yanchang returned home market people surrounded the shoulder carriage and pleaded, saying, "The Qi commander is innocent; we beg the chief ministers not to add punishment and cause the capital to be unsettled."

sentences.zh: 二相輿中喻之曰：「大政聖上委杜太尉，吾等不預。」

translations.literal: The two chief ministers explained from within the carriage, saying, "Great affairs the Sacred One entrusts to Grand Preceptor Du—we do not participate."
translations.idiomatic: The two chief ministers explained from within the carriage, saying, "Great affairs the Sacred One entrusts to Grand Preceptor Du—we do not participate."

sentences.zh: 市豪褰簾熟視，又不之識，因投瓦石，擊二相之輿。

translations.literal: Market bullies lifted the curtain and looked closely yet did not recognize them; therefore they threw tiles and stones and struck the two chief ministers' carriages.
translations.idiomatic: Market bullies lifted the curtain and looked closely yet did not recognize them; therefore they threw tiles and stones and struck the two chief ministers' carriages.

sentences.zh: 崔、鄭下輿散走，匿身獲免。

translations.literal: Cui and Zheng left the carriage and scattered fleeing; they hid and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Cui and Zheng left the carriage and scattered fleeing; they hid and escaped.

sentences.zh: 是日，喪堂印公服，天子怒，捕魁首誅之，由是用兵之意愈堅。

translations.literal: That day they lost hall seals and official robes; the Son of Heaven was angry, captured ringleaders and executed them—therefore the will to use troops grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: That day they lost hall seals and official robes; the Son of Heaven was angry, captured ringleaders and executed them—therefore the will to use troops grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 京師之人，相與藏竄，嚴刑不能已。

translations.literal: Capital people hid together; severe punishment could not stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Capital people hid together; severe punishment could not stop it.

sentences.zh: 讓能奏曰：「陛下初臨大寶，國步未安。

translations.literal: Rangneng submitted, saying, "Your Majesty has just acceded to the great treasure and the state's step is not yet settled.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng submitted, saying, "Your Majesty has just acceded to the great treasure and the state's step is not yet settled.

sentences.zh: 自艱難以來，且行貞元故事，姑息籓鎮。

translations.literal: Since hardship we have for a time followed the Zhenyuan precedent, soothing the frontier commands.
translations.idiomatic: Since hardship we have for a time followed the Zhenyuan precedent, soothing the frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 茂貞邇在國門，不宜起怨。

translations.literal: Maozhen is near the capital gate—it is not fitting to raise resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen is near the capital gate—it is not fitting to raise resentment.

sentences.zh: 臣料此時未可行也。」

translations.literal: Your subject calculates that at this time it cannot yet be done."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject calculates that at this time it cannot yet be done."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「政刑削弱，詔令不出城門，此賈生慟哭之際也。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Government and punishment are weakened; edicts do not leave the city gate—this is the moment for Jia Yi's wailing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Government and punishment are weakened; edicts do not leave the city gate—this is the moment for Jia Yi's wailing.

sentences.zh: 又《書》不雲乎？

translations.literal: Also does not the Book say?
translations.idiomatic: Also does not the Book say?

sentences.zh: 藥不瞑眩，厥疾弗瘳。

translations.literal: Medicine that does not cause dizziness will not cure the illness.
translations.idiomatic: Medicine that does not cause dizziness will not cure the illness.

sentences.zh: 朕不能孱孱度日，坐觀淩弱。

translations.literal: We cannot live feebly day by day and sit watching encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: We cannot live feebly day by day and sit watching encroachment.

sentences.zh: 卿為我主張調發，用兵吾委諸王。」

translations.literal: You plan dispatch and mobilization for Us; in using troops We entrust it to the princes."
translations.idiomatic: You plan dispatch and mobilization for Us; in using troops We entrust it to the princes."

sentences.zh: 讓能對曰：「陛下憤籓臣之倔強，必欲強幹弱枝以隆王室，此則中外大臣所宜戮力，以成陛下之誌，不宜獨任微臣。」

translations.literal: Rangneng replied, "Your Majesty resents the frontier ministers' stubbornness and must strengthen the trunk and weaken the branches to elevate the royal house—then inside and outside the great ministers should unite strength to fulfill Your Majesty's will; it is not fitting to entrust this alone to your humble subject."
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng replied, "Your Majesty resents the frontier ministers' stubbornness and must strengthen the trunk and weaken the branches to elevate the royal house—then inside and outside the great ministers should unite strength to fulfill Your Majesty's will; it is not fitting to entrust this alone to your humble subject."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿位居元輔，與朕同休共戚，無宜避事。」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "You stand at the summit of ministers and share with Us joy and sorrow—there is no reason to avoid affairs."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You stand at the summit of ministers and share with Us joy and sorrow—there is no reason to avoid affairs."

sentences.zh: 讓能泣辭曰：「臣待罪臺司，未乞骸骨者，思有以報國恩耳，安敢愛身避事？

translations.literal: Rangneng wept and declined, saying, "Your subject awaits punishment at the censorate and has not yet requested old bones because he thinks to repay national grace—how dare he cherish body and avoid affairs?
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng wept and declined, saying, "Your subject awaits punishment at the censorate and has not yet requested old bones because he thinks to repay national grace—how dare he cherish body and avoid affairs?

sentences.zh: 況陛下之心，憲祖之誌也。

translations.literal: Moreover Your Majesty's heart is Emperor Xianzong's will.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Your Majesty's heart is Emperor Xianzong's will.

sentences.zh: 但時有所不便，勢有所必然。

translations.literal: But sometimes the time is inconvenient and momentum has its necessity.
translations.idiomatic: But sometimes the time is inconvenient and momentum has its necessity.

sentences.zh: 他日臣雖受晁錯之誅，但不足以殄七國之患，敢不奉詔，繼之以死！」

translations.literal: Another day your subject may receive Chao Cuo's execution—but it will not suffice to extinguish the Seven States' trouble; I dare not refuse the edict and will follow with death!"
translations.idiomatic: Another day your subject may receive Chao Cuo's execution—but it will not suffice to extinguish the Seven States' trouble; I dare not refuse the edict and will follow with death!"

sentences.zh: 景福二年秋，上以嗣覃王為招討使，神策將李鐬副之，率禁軍三萬，送彥若赴鎮。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Jingfu the emperor made Prince of Siyin campaign commander with Shence General Li Hui as deputy, leading thirty thousand forbidden troops to escort Yanruo to his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year of Jingfu the emperor made Prince of Siyin campaign commander with Shence General Li Hui as deputy, leading thirty thousand forbidden troops to escort Yanruo to his command.

sentences.zh: 崔昭緯密與邠、鳳結托，心害讓能；

translations.literal: Cui Zhaowei secretly colluded with Bin and Feng; he hated Rangneng in heart;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhaowei secretly colluded with Bin and Feng; he hated Rangneng in heart;

sentences.zh: 言討伐非上意，出於大尉也。

translations.literal: he said the punitive campaign was not the emperor's intent but came from the Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: he said the punitive campaign was not the emperor's intent but came from the Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 九月，茂貞出軍逆戰，王師敗於盩啡。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Maozhen sent troops to meet in battle and the imperial army was defeated at Zhouzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Maozhen sent troops to meet in battle and the imperial army was defeated at Zhouzhi.

sentences.zh: 岐兵乘勝至三橋。

translations.literal: Qi troops seized victory and reached the Three Bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Qi troops seized victory and reached the Three Bridges.

sentences.zh: 讓能奏曰：「臣固預言之矣。

translations.literal: Rangneng submitted, saying, "Your subject indeed foretold this beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng submitted, saying, "Your subject indeed foretold this beforehand.

sentences.zh: 請歸罪於臣，可以紓難。」

translations.literal: Please return guilt to your subject and difficulty may be eased."
translations.idiomatic: Please return guilt to your subject and difficulty may be eased."

sentences.zh: 上涕下不能已，曰：「與卿訣矣。」

translations.literal: The emperor wept without stopping, saying, "We take leave of you."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept without stopping, saying, "We take leave of you."

sentences.zh: 即日貶為雷州司戶。

translations.literal: That same day he was demoted Assistant Administrator of Lei.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he was demoted Assistant Administrator of Lei.

sentences.zh: 茂貞在臨臯驛，請誅讓能。

translations.literal: Maozhen was at Lingao Post and requested Rangneng's execution.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen was at Lingao Post and requested Rangneng's execution.

sentences.zh: 尋賜死，時年五十三。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to die at age fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to die at age fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 駕自石門還京，念讓能之冤，追贈太師。

translations.literal: When the carriage returned from Shimen to the capital the emperor remembered Rangneng's injustice and posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage returned from Shimen to the capital the emperor remembered Rangneng's injustice and posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 子光乂、曉，以父枉橫，不求聞達。

translations.literal: His sons Guangyi and Xiao, because of their father's wrongful death, did not seek renown.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Guangyi and Xiao, because of their father's wrongful death, did not seek renown.

sentences.zh: 曉入梁，位亦至宰輔。

translations.literal: Xiao entered Liang and also reached chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao entered Liang and also reached chief minister.

sentences.zh: 彥林、弘徽，乾符中相次登進士第。

translations.literal: Yanlin and Honghui in the Qianfu era successively passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yanlin and Honghui in the Qianfu era successively passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 彥林，光化中累官至尚書郎、知制誥，拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: Yanlin, in the Guanghua era rose repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations and was appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yanlin, in the Guanghua era rose repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations and was appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 天祐初，為御史中丞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou he served as Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianyou he served as Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 弘徽，累官至中書舍人，遷戶部侍郎，充弘文館學士判館事，與兄同日被害。

translations.literal: Honghui rose repeatedly to Gentleman of the Secretariat, transferred Vice Minister of Revenue, and served as Hanlin Academician directing the Hall of Illustrious Culture; he and his elder brother were killed the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Honghui rose repeatedly to Gentleman of the Secretariat, transferred Vice Minister of Revenue, and served as Hanlin Academician directing the Hall of Illustrious Culture; he and his elder brother were killed the same day.

sentences.zh: 劉鄴，字漢籓，潤州句容人也。

translations.literal: Liu Ye, styled Hanfan, was a native of Jurong in Run Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ye, styled Hanfan, was a native of Jurong in Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父三復，聰敏絕人，幼善屬文。

translations.literal: His father Sanfu was extraordinarily intelligent from youth and skilled at composing prose.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sanfu was extraordinarily intelligent from youth and skilled at composing prose.

sentences.zh: 少孤貧，母有廢疾，三復丐食供養，不離左右，久之不遂鄉賦。

translations.literal: Orphaned young and poor, his mother had crippling illness; Sanfu begged food to support her and never left her side; for a long time he did not follow the local examination.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young and poor, his mother had crippling illness; Sanfu begged food to support her and never left her side; for a long time he did not follow the local examination.

sentences.zh: 長慶中，李德裕拜浙西觀察使，三復以德裕禁密大臣，以所業文詣郡幹謁。

translations.literal: In the Changqing era Li Deyu became Zhexi Observation Commissioner; Sanfu, because Deyu was a forbidden-secretariat great minister, took his literary work to the command to seek audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the Changqing era Li Deyu became Zhexi Observation Commissioner; Sanfu, because Deyu was a forbidden-secretariat great minister, took his literary work to the command to seek audience.

sentences.zh: 德裕閱其文，倒屣迎之，乃辟為從事，管記室。

translations.literal: Deyu read his writing, went out with shoes reversed to welcome him, and summoned him as staff member managing the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu read his writing, went out with shoes reversed to welcome him, and summoned him as staff member managing the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 母亡，哀毀殆不勝喪。

translations.literal: When his mother died his grief and destruction nearly exceeded what mourning could bear.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died his grief and destruction nearly exceeded what mourning could bear.

sentences.zh: 德裕三為浙西，凡十年，三復皆從之。

translations.literal: Deyu three times governed Zhexi; for ten years Sanfu always followed him.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu three times governed Zhexi; for ten years Sanfu always followed him.

sentences.zh: 太和中，德裕輔政，用為員外郎。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era when Deyu assisted governance Sanfu was used as Outer Court Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era when Deyu assisted governance Sanfu was used as Outer Court Attendant.

sentences.zh: 居無何，罷相，復鎮浙西，三復從之。

translations.literal: Within not long he was removed as chief minister, again governed Zhexi, and Sanfu followed him.
translations.idiomatic: Within not long he was removed as chief minister, again governed Zhexi, and Sanfu followed him.

sentences.zh: 汝州刺史劉禹錫以宗人遇之。

translations.literal: Prefect of Ru Liu Yuxi treated him as a clansman.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect of Ru Liu Yuxi treated him as a clansman.

sentences.zh: 深重其才，嘗為詩贈三復，序曰：「從弟三復，三為浙右從事，凡十余年。

translations.literal: Deeply valuing his talent, he once composed a poem presenting it to Sanfu with a preface saying, "Cousin Sanfu, three times staff member of Zheyou, altogether more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply valuing his talent, he once composed a poem presenting it to Sanfu with a preface saying, "Cousin Sanfu, three times staff member of Zheyou, altogether more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 往年主公入相，薦用登朝，中復從公之京口，未幾而罷。

translations.literal: In former years when the lord entered the chief-minister post he was recommended and used to ascend court; again he followed the lord to Jingkou and before long was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In former years when the lord entered the chief-minister post he was recommended and used to ascend court; again he followed the lord to Jingkou and before long was removed.

sentences.zh: 昨以尚書員外郎奉使至潞，旋承新命，改轅而東。

translations.literal: Yesterday as Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Revenue he was sent on mission to Lu; soon he received new appointment and changed carriage east.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday as Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of Revenue he was sent on mission to Lu; soon he received new appointment and changed carriage east.

sentences.zh: 三從公皆在舊地，征諸故事，夐無其比，因賦詩餞別以誌之。」

translations.literal: Three times following the lord all in old places—consulting precedents, far without parallel—therefore I compose a farewell poem to record it."
translations.idiomatic: Three times following the lord all in old places—consulting precedents, far without parallel—therefore I compose a farewell poem to record it."

sentences.zh: 又從德裕歷滑臺、西蜀、揚州，累遷御史中丞。

translations.literal: Again he followed Deyu through Hua Platform, Western Shu, and Yang Prefecture and was repeatedly promoted Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Again he followed Deyu through Hua Platform, Western Shu, and Yang Prefecture and was repeatedly promoted Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，德裕用事，自諫議、給事拜刑部侍郎、弘文館學士判館事。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era when Deyu held power, from Remonstrator and Supervising Censor he was appointed Vice Minister of Justice and Hanlin Academician directing the Hall of Illustrious Culture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era when Deyu held power, from Remonstrator and Supervising Censor he was appointed Vice Minister of Justice and Hanlin Academician directing the Hall of Illustrious Culture.

sentences.zh: 朝廷用兵誅劉稹，澤潞既平。

translations.literal: The court used troops to execute Liu Zhen and Ze-Lu was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The court used troops to execute Liu Zhen and Ze-Lu was pacified.

sentences.zh: 朝議以劉從諫妻裴氏是裴問之妹，欲原之。

translations.literal: Court discussion held that Liu Congjian's wife Lady Pei was younger sister of Pei Wen; they wished to pardon her.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion held that Liu Congjian's wife Lady Pei was younger sister of Pei Wen; they wished to pardon her.

sentences.zh: 法司定罪，以劉稹之叛，裴以酒食會潞州將校妻女，泣告以固逆謀。

translations.literal: The law office fixed guilt: because Liu Zhen rebelled Lady Pei with wine and food feasted Lu Prefecture officers' wives and daughters and wept telling them to fix the treason plan.
translations.idiomatic: The law office fixed guilt: because Liu Zhen rebelled Lady Pei with wine and food feasted Lu Prefecture officers' wives and daughters and wept telling them to fix the treason plan.

sentences.zh: 三復奏曰：

translations.literal: Sanfu submitted, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Sanfu submitted, saying:

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三復未幾病卒。

translations.literal: Before long Sanfu died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Sanfu died of illness.

sentences.zh: 鄴六七歲能賦詩，李德裕尤憐之，與諸子同硯席師學。

translations.literal: Ye at six or seven could compose poetry; Deyu especially cherished him and with his sons shared desk and teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Ye at six or seven could compose poetry; Deyu especially cherished him and with his sons shared desk and teacher.

sentences.zh: 大中初，德裕貶逐，鄴無所依，以文章客遊江、浙。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong when Deyu was demoted and sent away Ye had nowhere to rely and with writings lodged as guest traveling Jiang and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong when Deyu was demoted and sent away Ye had nowhere to rely and with writings lodged as guest traveling Jiang and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 每有制作，人皆稱誦。

translations.literal: Whenever he had compositions people all praised and recited them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he had compositions people all praised and recited them.

sentences.zh: 高元裕廉察陜虢，署為團練推官，得秘書省校書郎。

translations.literal: Gao Yuanyu inspected Shaan and Guo and retained him as training commission investigating officer; he obtained proofreader of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yuanyu inspected Shaan and Guo and retained him as training commission investigating officer; he obtained proofreader of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 咸通初，劉瞻、高璩居要職，以故人子薦為左拾遺，召充翰林學士，轉尚書郎中知制誥，正拜中書舍人、戶部侍郎、學士承旨。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiantong Liu Zhan and Gao Cong held important posts and as old friend's son recommended him Left Reminder; he was summoned Hanlin Academician, transferred Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue, and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiantong Liu Zhan and Gao Cong held important posts and as old friend's son recommended him Left Reminder; he was summoned Hanlin Academician, transferred Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat and Vice Minister of Revenue, and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鄴以李德裕貶死珠崖，大中朝以令狐綯當權，累有赦宥，不蒙恩例。

translations.literal: Because Li Deyu was demoted to die at Zhuya, in the Dazhong court Linghu Tao held power and though amnesties repeatedly came he did not receive the grace precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Because Li Deyu was demoted to die at Zhuya, in the Dazhong court Linghu Tao held power and though amnesties repeatedly came he did not receive the grace precedent.

sentences.zh: 懿宗即位，綯在方鎮，屬郊天大赦，鄴奏論之曰：「故崖州司戶參軍李德裕，其父吉甫，元和中以直道明誠，高居相位，中外鹹理，訏謨有功。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yizong acceded Tao was in a regional command; at the suburban great amnesty Ye submitted arguing, saying, "The former Assistant Administrator of Yai Prefecture Li Deyu—his father Jifu in the Yuanhe era with straight way and bright sincerity stood high in the chief-minister post; inside and outside all were ordered and his grand counsel had merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yizong acceded Tao was in a regional command; at the suburban great amnesty Ye submitted arguing, saying, "The former Assistant Administrator of Yai Prefecture Li Deyu—his father Jifu in the Yuanhe era with straight way and bright sincerity stood high in the chief-minister post; inside and outside all were ordered and his grand counsel had merit.

sentences.zh: 德裕以偉望宏才，繼登臺袞；

translations.literal: Deyu with great expectation and vast talent successively ascended the terrace and chief-minister's robe;
translations.idiomatic: Deyu with great expectation and vast talent successively ascended the terrace and chief-minister's robe;

sentences.zh: 險夷不易，勁正無群。

translations.literal: through danger and ease he did not change, stern and upright without clique.
translations.idiomatic: through danger and ease he did not change, stern and upright without clique.

sentences.zh: 稟周勃厚重之姿，慕楊秉忠貞之節。

translations.literal: He bore Zhou Bo's weighty bearing and admired Yang Bing's loyal and pure integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He bore Zhou Bo's weighty bearing and admired Yang Bing's loyal and pure integrity.

sentences.zh: 頃以微累，竄於遐荒，既迫衰殘，竟歸冥寞。

translations.literal: Recently because of slight trouble he was exiled to distant wilderness; already pressed by decline and infirmity he finally returned to the dark unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Recently because of slight trouble he was exiled to distant wilderness; already pressed by decline and infirmity he finally returned to the dark unknown.

sentences.zh: 其子燁坐貶象州立山縣尉。

translations.literal: His son Ye because of demotion served as Assistant Magistrate of Xiang Prefecture's Lishan County.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ye because of demotion served as Assistant Magistrate of Xiang Prefecture's Lishan County.

sentences.zh: 去年遇陛下布惟新之命，覃作解之恩，移授郴州郴縣尉，今已歿於貶所。

translations.literal: Last year encountering Your Majesty's renewal decree and broad pardon grace he was transferred Assistant Magistrate of Chen Prefecture's Chen County; now he has already died in the place of demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Last year encountering Your Majesty's renewal decree and broad pardon grace he was transferred Assistant Magistrate of Chen Prefecture's Chen County; now he has already died in the place of demotion.

sentences.zh: 倘德裕猶有親援，可期振揚，微臣固不敢上論，以招浮議。

translations.literal: If Deyu still had kin to rely on, restoration could be expected; your humble subject indeed dare not argue upward lest it invite floating criticism.
translations.idiomatic: If Deyu still had kin to rely on, restoration could be expected; your humble subject indeed dare not argue upward lest it invite floating criticism.

sentences.zh: 今骨肉將盡，生涯已空，皆傷棨戟之門，遽作荊榛之地；

translations.literal: Now flesh and bone are nearly exhausted and livelihood already empty—all wounding the halberd gate, suddenly becoming thorn and bramble land;
translations.idiomatic: Now flesh and bone are nearly exhausted and livelihood already empty—all wounding the halberd gate, suddenly becoming thorn and bramble land;

sentences.zh: 孤骨未歸於塋兆，一男又沒於湘江。

translations.literal: lonely bones have not returned to the tomb mound and one son again perished in the Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: lonely bones have not returned to the tomb mound and one son again perished in the Xiang River.

sentences.zh: 特乞聖明，俯垂哀湣，俾還遺骨，兼賜贈官。

translations.literal: I specially beg the sage brightness to bend and show pity, enabling return of the remaining bones and also granting posthumous office.
translations.idiomatic: I specially beg the sage brightness to bend and show pity, enabling return of the remaining bones and also granting posthumous office.

sentences.zh: 上弘錄舊之仁，下激徇公之節。」

translations.literal: Above to expand the grace of recording the old; below to stimulate the integrity of giving oneself for the public."
translations.idiomatic: Above to expand the grace of recording the old; below to stimulate the integrity of giving oneself for the public."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed this.

sentences.zh: 鄴尋以本官領諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Ye soon with his existing office directed Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Ye soon with his existing office directed Salt and Iron Transport for All Circuits.

sentences.zh: 其年同平章事，判度支，轉中書侍郎，兼吏部尚書，累加太清宮使、弘文館大學士。

translations.literal: That year he became Associate Chief Minister, Director of the Revenue Bureau, transferred Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Personnel, and was repeatedly added Commissioner of the Great Pure Palace and Grand Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture.
translations.idiomatic: That year he became Associate Chief Minister, Director of the Revenue Bureau, transferred Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Personnel, and was repeatedly added Commissioner of the Great Pure Palace and Grand Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Culture.

sentences.zh: 僖宗即位，蕭倣、崔彥昭秉政，素惡鄴，乃罷鄴知政事，檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong acceded Xiao Fang and Cui Yanzhao directed governance and always disliked Ye; they removed Ye from governing affairs and appointed Acting Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Associate Chief Minister, Chief Administrator of Yang Superior Protectorate, and Huainan Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xizong acceded Xiao Fang and Cui Yanzhao directed governance and always disliked Ye; they removed Ye from governing affairs and appointed Acting Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Associate Chief Minister, Chief Administrator of Yang Superior Protectorate, and Huainan Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是日鄴押班宣麻竟，通事引鄴內殿謝，不及笏記，鄴自敘十余句語云：「霖雨無功，深愧代天之用；

translations.literal: That day when Ye finished proclaiming the edict as ranking officer the usher led Ye inside the hall to give thanks; without tablet notes Ye himself narrated more than ten sentences, saying, "Long rain without merit—deeply ashamed at substituting for heaven's use;

translations.literal: cloud ladder lost the way—not knowing the day bones return."
translations.idiomatic: cloud ladder lost the way—not knowing the day bones return."

sentences.zh: 帝為之惻然。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved for him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved for him.

sentences.zh: 黃巢渡淮而南，詔以浙西高駢代還，尋除風翔尹、鳳翔隴右節度使，以疾辭，拜左僕射。

translations.literal: When Huang Chao crossed the Huai south an edict had Gao Pian of Zhexi replace him; soon he was removed Chief of Fengxiang and Fengxiang-Long Right Military Commissioner; he pleaded illness and was appointed Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao crossed the Huai south an edict had Gao Pian of Zhexi replace him; soon he was removed Chief of Fengxiang and Fengxiang-Long Right Military Commissioner; he pleaded illness and was appointed Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 巢賊犯長安，鄴從駕不及，與崔沆、豆盧瑑匿於金吾將軍張直方之家。

translations.literal: When the bandits attacked Chang'an Ye could not follow the carriage and with Cui Hang and Dou Luzhan hid in General of the Golden Guard Zhang Zhifang's house.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits attacked Chang'an Ye could not follow the carriage and with Cui Hang and Dou Luzhan hid in General of the Golden Guard Zhang Zhifang's house.

sentences.zh: 旬日，賊嚴切追捕，三人夜竄；

translations.literal: After ten days the bandits strictly pursued; the three men fled by night;
translations.idiomatic: After ten days the bandits strictly pursued; the three men fled by night;

sentences.zh: 為賊所得，迫以偽命，稱病不應，俱為賊所害。

translations.literal: they were seized by bandits, forced with false appointments, claimed illness and did not respond, and all were harmed by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: they were seized by bandits, forced with false appointments, claimed illness and did not respond, and all were harmed by bandits.

sentences.zh: 豆盧瑑者，河東人。

translations.literal: Dou Luzhan was a native of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Luzhan was a native of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 祖願，父籍，皆以進士擢第。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuan and father Ji both passed the jinshi selection.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuan and father Ji both passed the jinshi selection.

sentences.zh: 瑑，大中十三年亦登進士科。

translations.literal: Zhan, in the thirteenth year of Dazhong also passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan, in the thirteenth year of Dazhong also passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 咸通末，累遷兵部員外郎，轉戶部郎中知制誥，召充翰林學士，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the end of Xiantong he was repeatedly promoted Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War, transferred Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, summoned Hanlin Academician, and formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xiantong he was repeatedly promoted Outer Court Attendant in the Ministry of War, transferred Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Drafting Officer for Proclamations, summoned Hanlin Academician, and formally appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乾符中，累遷戶部侍郎、學士承旨。

translations.literal: In the Qianfu era he was repeatedly promoted Vice Minister of Revenue and Drafting Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianfu era he was repeatedly promoted Vice Minister of Revenue and Drafting Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年，與吏部侍郎崔沆同日拜平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he and Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Cui Hang on the same day became Associate Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he and Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Cui Hang on the same day became Associate Chief Minister.

sentences.zh: 宣制曰，大風雷雨拔樹。

translations.literal: When the edict was proclaimed, great wind, thunder, and rain uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was proclaimed, great wind, thunder, and rain uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 左丞韋蟾與王瑑善，往賀之。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Wei Chan was friendly with Wang Zhuan and went to congratulate him.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Wei Chan was friendly with Wang Zhuan and went to congratulate him.

sentences.zh: 瑑言及雷雨之異，蟾曰：「此應相公為霖作解之祥也。」

translations.literal: Zhan spoke of the thunder and rain anomaly; Chan said, "This responds to the chief minister making rain and releasing the oath as auspicious."
translations.idiomatic: Zhan spoke of the thunder and rain anomaly; Chan said, "This responds to the chief minister making rain and releasing the oath as auspicious."

sentences.zh: 瑑笑答曰：「霖何甚耶？」

translations.literal: Zhan smiled and replied, "How very much rain!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhan smiled and replied, "How very much rain!"

sentences.zh: 及巢賊犯京師，從僖宗出開遠門，為盜所制，乃匿於張直方之家，遇害。

translations.literal: When the bandits attacked the capital he followed Emperor Xizong out the Kaiyuan Gate, was seized by robbers, then hid in Zhang Zhifang's house and met harm.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits attacked the capital he followed Emperor Xizong out the Kaiyuan Gate, was seized by robbers, then hid in Zhang Zhifang's house and met harm.

sentences.zh: 識者以風雷，不令之兆也。

translations.literal: Observers held the wind and thunder an omen of ill appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Observers held the wind and thunder an omen of ill appointment.

sentences.zh: 弟瓚、璨，皆進士登第，累歷清要。

translations.literal: Younger brothers Zan and Can both passed the jinshi examination and repeatedly held pure and important posts.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brothers Zan and Can both passed the jinshi examination and repeatedly held pure and important posts.

sentences.zh: 瓚子革，中興位亦至宰輔。

translations.literal: Zan's son Ge in the Restoration also reached chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zan's son Ge in the Restoration also reached chief minister.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：近代衣冠人物，門族昌盛，從、颋之後，實富名流。

translations.literal: The historian says: In recent times among robed gentry and persons, clans flourished; after Cong and Ting there were truly many famous streams.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: In recent times among robed gentry and persons, clans flourished; after Cong and Ting there were truly many famous streams.

sentences.zh: 而彥曾屬徐亂之秋，胤接李亡之數，計則繆矣，天可逃乎？

translations.literal: Yet Yanzeng belonged to the season of Xu disorder and Yin met the fate of Li's fall—the plan was wrong; can heaven be escaped?
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yanzeng belonged to the season of Xu disorder and Yin met the fate of Li's fall—the plan was wrong; can heaven be escaped?

sentences.zh: 楊、劉、曹畢諸族，門非世胄，位以藝升，伏膺典墳，俯拾青紫。

translations.literal: The Yang, Liu, Cao, and Bi clans—gates not of hereditary nobility, ranks risen through art, bowing to the classics and picking up purple and green.
translations.idiomatic: The Yang, Liu, Cao, and Bi clans—gates not of hereditary nobility, ranks risen through art, bowing to the classics and picking up purple and green.

sentences.zh: 而收得位求侈，以至敗名。

translations.literal: Yet Shou obtaining rank sought extravagance until he ruined his name.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Shou obtaining rank sought extravagance until he ruined his name.

sentences.zh: 行己飭躬，此為深誡！

translations.literal: To discipline oneself and adorn the person—this is a deep warning!
translations.idiomatic: To discipline oneself and adorn the person—this is a deep warning!

sentences.zh: 杜氏三世輔相，太尉陷於橫流，臨難忘身，可為流涕。

translations.literal: The Du clan for three generations assisted as chief ministers; the Grand Preceptor fell in the cross current—facing difficulty without forgetting self, one may weep for this.
translations.idiomatic: The Du clan for three generations assisted as chief ministers; the Grand Preceptor fell in the cross current—facing difficulty without forgetting self, one may weep for this.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：漢代荀、陳，我朝崔、杜。

translations.literal: The praise says: Han had Xun and Chen; our court has Cui and Du.
translations.idiomatic: The praise says: Han had Xun and Chen; our court has Cui and Du.

sentences.zh: 有子有弟，多登宰輔。

translations.literal: With sons and with younger brothers, many ascended chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: With sons and with younger brothers, many ascended chief minister.

sentences.zh: 裴士改節，楊子敗名。

translations.literal: Pei the scholar changed his nature; Yang the son ruined his name.
translations.idiomatic: Pei the scholar changed his nature; Yang the son ruined his name.

sentences.zh: 膏粱移性，信而有征。

translations.literal: Rich food shifts character—believed and there is proof.
translations.idiomatic: Rich food shifts character—believed and there is proof.
